items.title_en: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
items.abstract_en: Deeper neural networks are more difficult to train. We present a residual learning framework to ease the training of networks that are substantially deeper than those used previously. We explicitly reformulate the layers as learning residual functions with reference to the layer inputs, instead of learning unreferenced functions. We provide comprehensive empirical evidence showing that these residual networks are easier to optimize, and can gain accuracy from considerably increased depth. On the ImageNet dataset we evaluate residual nets with a depth of up to 152 layers---8x deeper than VGG nets but still having lower complexity. An ensemble of these residual nets achieves 3.57% error on the ImageNet test set. This result won the 1st place on the ILSVRC 2015 classification task. We also present analysis on CIFAR-10 with 100 and 1000 layers. The depth of representations is of central importance for many visual recognition tasks. Solely due to our extremely deep representations, we obtain a 28% relative improvement on the COCO object detection dataset. Deep residual nets are foundations of our submissions to ILSVRC & COCO 2015 competitions, where we also won the 1st places on the tasks of ImageNet detection, ImageNet localization, COCO detection, and COCO segmentation.

items.title_zh: 用于图像识别的深度残差学习
items.abstract_zh: 更深的神经网络更难训练。我们提出一个残差学习框架，以缓解训练比以往所用网络实质上更深的网络的困难。我们显式地将层重新表述为学习参照层输入的残差函数，而不是学习无参照的函数。我们提供全面的经验证据，表明这些残差网络更容易优化，并且能够从显著增加的深度中获得精度。在 ImageNet 数据集上，我们评估深度达 152 层的残差网络——比 VGG 网络深 8 倍，但复杂度仍更低。这些残差网络的集成在 ImageNet 测试集上取得 3.57% 误差。该结果在 ILSVRC 2015 分类任务中获得第 1 名。我们还对具有 100 层和 1000 层的 CIFAR-10 进行分析。表示的深度对许多视觉识别任务至关重要。仅由于我们极深的表示，我们在 COCO 目标检测数据集上获得 28% 的相对改进。深度残差网络是我们提交给 ILSVRC 与 COCO 2015 竞赛的基础，在这些竞赛中我们还获得了 ImageNet 检测、ImageNet 定位、COCO 检测和 COCO 分割任务的第 1 名。

items.title_en: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
items.abstract_en: Abstract Proteins are essential to life, and understanding their structure can facilitate a mechanistic understanding of their function. Through an enormous experimental effort 1–4 , the structures of around 100,000 unique proteins have been determined 5 , but this represents a small fraction of the billions of known protein sequences 6,7 . Structural coverage is bottlenecked by the months to years of painstaking effort required to determine a single protein structure. Accurate computational approaches are needed to address this gap and to enable large-scale structural bioinformatics. Predicting the three-dimensional structure that a protein will adopt based solely on its amino acid sequence—the structure prediction component of the ‘protein folding problem’ 8 —has been an important open research problem for more than 50 years 9 . Despite recent progress 10–14 , existing methods fall far short of atomic accuracy, especially when no homologous structure is available. Here we provide the first computational method that can regularly predict protein structures with atomic accuracy even in cases in which no similar structure is known. We validated an entirely redesigned version of our neural network-based model, AlphaFold, in the challenging 14th Critical Assessment of protein Structure Prediction (CASP14) 15 , demonstrating accuracy competitive with experimental structures in a majority of cases and greatly outperforming other methods. Underpinning the latest version of AlphaFold is a novel machine learning approach that incorporates physical and biological knowledge about protein structure, leveraging multi-sequence alignments, into the design of the deep learning algorithm.

items.title_zh: 使用 AlphaFold 进行高精度蛋白质结构预测
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 蛋白质对生命至关重要，理解其结构有助于对其功能进行机制性理解。通过巨大的实验努力1–4，已确定约100,000种独特蛋白质的结构5，但这仅代表数十亿已知蛋白质序列6,7中的一小部分。结构覆盖受限于确定单个蛋白质结构需要数月到数年的艰苦努力。需要准确的计算方法来弥补这一差距，并实现大规模结构生物信息学。仅基于氨基酸序列预测蛋白质将采用的三维结构——即“蛋白质折叠问题”8的结构预测组成部分——50多年来一直是一个重要的开放研究问题9。尽管近期取得进展10–14，现有方法仍远未达到原子精度，尤其是在没有同源结构可用时。在这里，我们提供首个计算方法，即使在没有已知相似结构的情况下，也能常规地以原子精度预测蛋白质结构。我们在具有挑战性的第14届蛋白质结构预测关键评估（CASP14）15中验证了完全重新设计的基于神经网络的模型 AlphaFold，证明在大多数情况下精度可与实验结构竞争，并大幅优于其他方法。最新版 AlphaFold 的基础是一种新颖的机器学习方法，它将关于蛋白质结构的物理和生物学知识（利用多序列比对）纳入深度学习算法的设计中。

items.title_en: All-Optical Machine Learning Using Diffractive Deep Neural Networks
items.abstract_en: We introduce an all-optical Diffractive Deep Neural Network (D2NN) architecture that can learn to implement various functions after deep learning-based design of passive diffractive layers that work collectively. We experimentally demonstrated the success of this framework by creating 3D-printed D2NNs that learned to implement handwritten digit classification and the function of an imaging lens at terahertz spectrum. With the existing plethora of 3D-printing and other lithographic fabrication methods as well as spatial-light-modulators, this all-optical deep learning framework can perform, at the speed of light, various complex functions that computer-based neural networks can implement, and will find applications in all-optical image analysis, feature detection and object classification, also enabling new camera designs and optical components that can learn to perform unique tasks using D2NNs.

items.title_zh: 使用衍射深度神经网络的全光学机器学习
items.abstract_zh: 我们介绍一种全光学衍射深度神经网络（D2NN）架构，该架构在基于深度学习设计被动衍射层后，能够学习实现各种功能，这些衍射层协同工作。我们通过创建3D打印的D2NN，在太赫兹频谱上学习实现手写数字分类和成像透镜功能，实验证明了该框架的成功。借助现有的大量3D打印和其他光刻制造方法以及空间光调制器，这种全光学深度学习框架可以以光速执行基于计算机的神经网络能够实现的各种复杂功能，并将在全光学图像分析、特征检测和对象分类中找到应用，同时也使新的相机设计和光学组件成为可能，这些组件可以使用D2NN学习执行独特任务。

items.title_en: XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System
items.abstract_en: Tree boosting is a highly effective and widely used machine learning method. In this paper, we describe a scalable end-to-end tree boosting system called XGBoost, which is used widely by data scientists to achieve state-of-the-art results on many machine learning challenges. We propose a novel sparsity-aware algorithm for sparse data and weighted quantile sketch for approximate tree learning. More importantly, we provide insights on cache access patterns, data compression and sharding to build a scalable tree boosting system. By combining these insights, XGBoost scales beyond billions of examples using far fewer resources than existing systems.

items.title_zh: XGBoost：一个可扩展的树提升系统
items.abstract_zh: 树提升是一种非常有效且广泛使用的机器学习方法。在本文中，我们描述一个名为 XGBoost 的可扩展端到端树提升系统，数据科学家广泛使用它在许多机器学习挑战中取得最先进的结果。我们提出一种针对稀疏数据的新型稀疏感知算法，以及用于近似树学习的加权分位数草图。更重要的是，我们提供关于缓存访问模式、数据压缩和分片的见解，以构建可扩展的树提升系统。通过结合这些见解，XGBoost 使用比现有系统少得多的资源，扩展到超过数十亿个样本。

items.title_en: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
items.abstract_en: We introduce a new language representation model called BERT, which stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers. Unlike recent language representation models, BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context in all layers. As a result, the pre-trained BERT model can be fine-tuned with just one additional output layer to create state-of-the-art models for a wide range of tasks, such as question answering and language inference, without substantial task-specific architecture modifications. BERT is conceptually simple and empirically powerful. It obtains new state-of-the-art results on eleven natural language processing tasks, including pushing the GLUE score to 80.5% (7.7% point absolute improvement), MultiNLI accuracy to 86.7% (4.6% absolute improvement), SQuAD v1.1 question answering Test F1 to 93.2 (1.5 point absolute improvement) and SQuAD v2.0 Test F1 to 83.1 (5.1 point absolute improvement).

items.title_zh: BERT：用于语言理解的深层双向 Transformer 预训练
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种新的语言表示模型 BERT，即基于 Transformer 的双向编码器表示。与近期的语言表示模型不同，BERT 通过在所有层中同时以左侧和右侧上下文为条件，从无标注文本中预训练深层双向表示。因此，预训练的 BERT 只需增加一个输出层进行微调，即可在问答、语言推断等广泛任务上构建最优模型，而无需对任务特定结构做大幅修改。BERT 概念简单而实证有力，在 11 项自然语言处理任务上取得新的最优结果：GLUE 分数提升至 80.5%（绝对提升 7.7 个百分点），MultiNLI 准确率提升至 86.7%（绝对提升 4.6），SQuAD v1.1 问答测试 F1 提升至 93.2（绝对提升 1.5），SQuAD v2.0 测试 F1 提升至 83.1（绝对提升 5.1）。
items.highlight_zh: 双向预训练 + 一層微调，刷新 11 项 NLP 任务纪录
items.digest_zh: 【研究问题】如何让机器更好地“读懂”语言。此前的语言表示模型多为单向：只能从左到右看上下文，理解句意时信息不完整。【方法】BERT 用 Transformer 的编码器结构，在所有层中同时利用左右两侧的上下文来做预训练，从而得到“深层双向”的语言表示。使用时不需要为每个任务重新设计复杂网络，只要在预训练模型上加一个输出层做微调，就能迁移到问答、语言推断等各种任务。【结果】在 11 项自然语言处理任务上刷新最优成绩：GLUE 总分达到 80.5%（绝对提升 7.7 个百分点），MultiNLI 准确率 86.7%，SQuAD v1.1 测试 F1 为 93.2，SQuAD v2.0 测试 F1 为 83.1。【为何重要】它证明了“通用预训练 + 轻量微调”这一范式的强大与普适：一个模型可以服务大量下游任务，大幅降低为每个任务单独建模的成本，并成为后续语言模型研究的重要基础。

items.title_en: ORB-SLAM3: An Accurate Open-Source Library for Visual, Visual-Inertial and Multi-Map SLAM
items.abstract_en: This paper presents ORB-SLAM3, the first system able to perform visual, visual-inertial and multi-map SLAM with monocular, stereo and RGB-D cameras, using pin-hole and fisheye lens models. The first main novelty is a feature-based tightly-integrated visual-inertial SLAM system that fully relies on Maximum-a-Posteriori (MAP) estimation, even during the IMU initialization phase. The result is a system that operates robustly in real-time, in small and large, indoor and outdoor environments, and is 2 to 5 times more accurate than previous approaches. The second main novelty is a multiple map system that relies on a new place recognition method with improved recall. Thanks to it, ORB-SLAM3 is able to survive to long periods of poor visual information: when it gets lost, it starts a new map that will be seamlessly merged with previous maps when revisiting mapped areas. Compared with visual odometry systems that only use information from the last few seconds, ORB-SLAM3 is the first system able to reuse in all the algorithm stages all previous information. This allows to include in bundle adjustment co-visible keyframes, that provide high parallax observations boosting accuracy, even if they are widely separated in time or if they come from a previous mapping session. Our experiments show that, in all sensor configurations, ORB-SLAM3 is as robust as the best systems available in the literature, and significantly more accurate. Notably, our stereo-inertial SLAM achieves an average accuracy of 3.6 cm on the EuRoC drone and 9 mm under quick hand-held motions in the room of TUM-VI dataset, a setting representative of AR/VR scenarios. For the benefit of the community we make public the source code.

items.title_zh: ORB-SLAM3：面向视觉、视觉惯性与多地图 SLAM 的高精度开源库
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 ORB-SLAM3，这是首个能在单目、双目和 RGB-D 相机上，并支持针孔与鱼眼镜头模型，同时完成视觉、视觉惯性与多地图 SLAM 的系统。第一个创新点是基于特征的紧耦合视觉惯性 SLAM 系统，即使在 IMU 初始化阶段也完全依赖最大后验（MAP）估计，因而能在室内外、大大小小的场景中实时稳健运行，精度比以往方法高 2 至 5 倍。第二个创新点是多地图系统，它依赖一种召回率更高的新地点识别方法：当视觉信息长期匮乏而跟丢时，系统会新建地图，并在重访已建图区域时与旧地图无缝融合。与只利用最近几秒信息的视觉里程计不同，ORB-SLAM3 是首个在所有算法环节复用全部历史信息的系统，使共视关键帧即便在时间上相隔很远或来自此前的建图会话，也能参与光束法平差，从而提供高视差观测、提升精度。实验显示，在所有传感器配置下，ORB-SLAM3 的稳健性与文献中最好的系统相当，且精度显著更高。特别地，其双目惯性 SLAM 在 EuRoC 无人机数据集上平均精度为 3.6 厘米，在 TUM-VI 数据集的房间快速手持运动场景下为 9 毫米，该场景可代表 AR/VR 应用。为便于社区使用，我们公开了源代码。
items.highlight_zh: 首个统一视觉/视觉惯性/多地图的开源 SLAM，精度提升 2–5 倍
items.digest_zh: 【研究问题】机器人和 AR/VR 设备需要一边移动一边知道自己在哪里、周围长什么样（SLAM）。难点在于：不同相机与传感器要统一支持，传感器初始化不稳，以及长时间视野不佳时容易“跟丢”。【方法】ORB-SLAM3 有两大创新。其一，把相机和惯性测量单元（IMU）紧耦合，全流程（包括 IMU 初始化）都用最大后验估计统一求解，支持单目、双目、RGB-D 以及针孔、鱼眼镜头。其二，引入召回率更高的地点识别，实现“多地图”：跟丢后新建地图，重访旧区域时自动合并；且所有历史信息在各环节都能复用，时间上相隔很远的关键帧也能参与光束法平差，提供大视差约束。【结果】实时稳健运行，精度比以往方法高 2–5 倍；双目惯性在 EuRoC 无人机上平均 3.6 厘米，TUM-VI 手持快速运动中达 9 毫米。【为何重要】它把多种传感器配置与长期建图统一到一个开源系统中，精度和稳健性都达到领先水平，且代码公开，便于学术界与工业界直接使用。

items.title_en: Video-Coder: Reinforcing Agentic Coding for Video Generation
items.title_zh: Video-Coder：强化智能体式编程以驱动视频生成
items.abstract_en: Recent years have witnessed remarkable progress in video generation in terms of visual quality and temporal consistency. However, generating videos with precise spatial structure, coherent motion dynamics, and controllable scene composition remains challenging. In this paper, we introduce Video-Coder, the first attempt to train a code-driven video generation agent, which autonomously writes and executes code to construct a dynamic 3D scene (Draft Video) that provides structure and motion signals to downstream video generators. To support this paradigm, we design a dedicated data pipeline and curate two high-quality datasets, Video-Coder-SFT-6k and Video-Coder-RL-2k, which contain diverse prompts and ground-truth reference videos. We further develop the Video- Coder Harness, a unified interactive environment integrating code execution, 3D scene rendering, and execution feedback for agent training and inference. We then train Video-Coder with SFT fol- lowed by harness-native agentic reinforcement learning with dual reward feedback, which combines execution-based and video-based rewards. Additionally, we design an annealing training strategy that gradually reduces the execution reward over time, allowing the model to rely more on the video reward in the later training stages. Experiments show that Video-Coder achieves significant gains, improving Minimax-H3 by approximately 7 points on PhyGenBench and 24 points on VBench-2.0. We hope this work can serve as an open foundation for coding agents in video generation, and we fully open-source our data, models, and code
items.abstract_zh: 近年来视频生成在视觉质量与时间一致性上进展显著，但生成具有精确空间结构、连贯运动动态和可控场景构成的视频仍然困难。本文提出 Video-Coder，首次尝试训练一个代码驱动的视频生成智能体：它自主编写并执行代码来构建动态 3D 场景（称为 Draft Video），为下游视频生成器提供结构与运动信号。为支撑这一范式，我们设计了专门的数据流水线，构建了包含多样提示词与真值参考视频的两个高质量数据集 Video-Coder-SFT-6k 与 Video-Coder-RL-2k；并开发 Video-Coder Harness，一个集代码执行、3D 场景渲染与执行反馈于一体、用于智能体训练与推理的统一交互环境。我们先用 SFT 训练 Video-Coder，再进行环境原生的智能体强化学习，采用结合执行奖励与视频奖励的双重反馈；还设计了退火训练策略，随时间逐渐降低执行奖励，使模型在训练后期更多依赖视频奖励。实验表明 Video-Coder 增益显著：在 PhyGenBench 上比 Minimax-H3 提高约 7 分，在 VBench-2.0 上提高 24 分。我们希望该工作成为视频生成中编程智能体的开放基础，并已完全开源数据、模型与代码。
items.highlight_zh: 让智能体写代码搭 3D 场景，为视频生成提供结构与运动
items.digest_zh: 【研究问题】现有视频生成模型画质和连贯性已不错，但很难精确控制画面里的空间结构、物体运动和场景构成。【方法】Video-Coder 换了个思路：不让模型直接“画”视频，而是训练一个智能体先写代码、执行代码，搭出一个动态 3D 场景，作为“草稿视频”（Draft Video），把结构和运动信息交给下游视频生成器。为此作者构建了两套数据集（SFT-6k、RL-2k）和一个统一环境 Harness，把代码执行、3D 渲染与执行反馈打通；训练上先做监督微调，再做智能体强化学习，奖励由“代码是否执行成功”和“生成视频好不好”两部分组成，并采用退火策略逐步削弱执行奖励，让模型后期更看重视频质量。【结果】相比 Minimax-H3，在 PhyGenBench 上提升约 7 分，在 VBench-2.0 上提升 24 分。【为何重要】它把“写代码”变成视频生成的可控中间层，为结构精确、可编辑的视频生成提供新范式，且数据、模型、代码全部开源。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Microenvironmental Fingerprint of Maturing Tau Condensates from Spectral and Lifetime Phasor Analysis of a Solvatochromic Dye
items.title_zh: 成熟中 Tau 凝聚体微环境指纹：溶剂化显色染料的光谱与寿命相量分析
items.abstract_en: Solvatochromic dyes respond to changes in their local environment through variations in both spectral properties and fluorescence lifetime. These responses arise from the excited-state behavior of the probe, but the sensitivity of each response to a given environment can differ. In this work, we developed a multimodal phasor-based framework for two-photon spectral and fluorescence lifetime imaging analysis. To validate the framework, we imaged the solvatochromic dye ACDAN in water, glycerol, and ethanol. ACDAN showed clear spectral differences among the three solvents, whereas its fluorescence lifetime separated water from both organic solvents but not glycerol from ethanol, indicating that the two observables respond differently to the same environmental change. We then applied ACDAN to a well-described model system, the maturation of liquid-liquid phase-separated condensates of the microtubule-binding, neurodegeneration-related protein Tau into later-stage assemblies. Across Tau samples incubated for 1, 4, and 48 h, a progressive decrease in the ACDAN spectral phasor angle {theta} and increase in its phase-derived lifetime {tau}P suggested increasingly restricted dipolar relaxation in the probe environment. Differences among condensates were apparent by 4 h, whereas pronounced spatial heterogeneity within assemblies was observed at 48 h. Lastly, we evaluated the multimodal framework on Tau assemblies labeled with the fluorogenic probe Thioflavin T. As expected, this dye predominantly sensed its environment through its fluorescence lifetime, with comparatively limited spectral changes, whereas ACDAN reported microenvironmental changes in both coordinates. Together, this framework combines spectral and lifetime descriptors to characterize changes in the fluorescence response across Tau assembly maturation while retaining their spatial distribution.
items.abstract_zh: 溶剂化显色染料会通过光谱性质与荧光寿命的变化，响应局部环境的改变；这两种响应源于探针的激发态行为，但各自对特定环境的敏感度可能不同。本文建立了一个基于相量的多模态框架，用于双光子光谱与荧光寿命成像分析。为验证该框架，我们对水、甘油和乙醇中的溶剂化显色染料 ACDAN 成像：ACDAN 在三种溶剂间呈现明显光谱差异，而荧光寿命只能区分水与两种有机溶剂，无法区分甘油与乙醇，说明两种观测量对同一环境变化的响应并不相同。随后我们将 ACDAN 应用于一个已被充分描述的模型体系——微管结合、与神经退行相关的蛋白 Tau 的液-液相分离凝聚体成熟为后期组装体的过程。在孵育 1、4、48 小时的 Tau 样品中，ACDAN 光谱相量角 θ 逐步减小、相量导出的寿命 τP 增大，提示探针所处环境的偶极弛豫逐渐受限；4 小时时凝聚体间差异已可分辨，48 小时则在组装体内部观察到明显的空间异质性。最后，我们在用荧光探针 Thioflavin T 标记的 Tau 组装体上评估该多模态框架：该染料如预期主要经荧光寿命感知环境，光谱变化相对有限，而 ACDAN 在两个维度上都报告出微环境变化。综上，该框架结合光谱与寿命两种描述符来表征荧光响应变化。
items.highlight_zh: 光谱+寿命双维度相量分析，刻画 Tau 凝聚体成熟微环境
items.digest_zh: 【研究问题】蛋白 Tau 的液-液相分离凝聚体会逐渐“成熟”为更有序的组装体，这与神经退行疾病相关；但如何在不扰动样品的前提下，读出凝聚体内部微环境的变化，是个难题。【方法】作者使用对局部环境敏感的溶剂化显色染料 ACDAN，它同时会改变光谱和荧光寿命。研究者搭建了基于相量（phasor）的多模态分析框架，同时处理双光子光谱成像与荧光寿命成像数据。先在已知溶剂中校准，再跟踪 Tau 凝聚体在 1、4、48 小时的成熟过程，并与常用染料 Thioflavin T 对比。【结果】在纯溶剂中，光谱能区分水、甘油、乙醇三者，而寿命只能区分水与有机溶剂，甘油与乙醇分不开——证明两种读数互补。用于 Tau 时，随时间推移光谱相量角 θ 减小、相量导出寿命 τP 增大，说明探针周围偶极弛豫越来越受限；4 小时已见凝聚体间差异，48 小时出现明显的空间异质性。Thioflavin T 主要靠寿命感知环境，光谱变化有限。【为何重要】该框架把两种互补的荧光读数纳入同一分析，为无标记式地刻画蛋白凝聚体微环境及其演化提供了灵敏工具。

items.title_en: DiffSequence-Q: Diffusion Design with Quantum Assistance for Biologically Active Proteins
items.title_zh: DiffSequence-Q：量子辅助的扩散式生物活性蛋白设计
items.abstract_en: Designing protein sequences that satisfy both secondary structure requirements and solubility targets remains challenging. We present DiffSequence-Q, a hybrid multinomial diffusion model conditioned on secondary structure at each residue and a continuous solubility target. To introduce quantum auxiliary supervision during training, we employ a quantum neural network (QNN) or quantum Kolmogorov-Arnold network (QKAN) as an auxiliary solubility prediction head over shared Transformer representations. The auxiliary prediction loss is jointly optimized with the diffusion objective, allowing quantum auxiliary supervision to influence the learned denoising model. Once trained, protein sequences are generated entirely through classical reverse diffusion. On the CATH benchmark, DiffSequence-Q achieved the highest secondary structure recovery among the four evaluated models for complete sequence generation. Evaluation with a separately trained solubility prediction model showed that the best QNN and QKAN configurations achieved mean predicted solubility scores 14.0% and 22.7% higher than the multilayer perceptron (MLP) baseline, respectively. Experimental characterization further demonstrated biological activity across three distinct protein families. Selected defensins exhibited pronounced inhibitory activity against Aspergillus niger, while xylanases and short-chain dehydrogenases exhibited substantial enzymatic activity. Together, these results support DiffSequence-Q as a framework for integrating structural requirements and solubility targets in protein generation, with experimentally demonstrated biological activity.
items.abstract_zh: 设计同时满足二级结构与溶解度目标的蛋白质序列仍具挑战。我们提出 DiffSequence-Q：一种混合多项扩散模型，以逐残基二级结构和连续溶解度目标为条件。训练时在共享 Transformer 表示之上接量子神经网络（QNN）或量子 Kolmogorov–Arnold 网络（QKAN）作为辅助溶解度预测头，其损失与扩散目标联合优化，让量子辅助监督影响学到的去噪模型；生成阶段仅用经典反向扩散。在 CATH 基准上，其完整序列生成的二级结构恢复率在四个评估模型中最高；最佳 QNN 与 QKAN 配置的平均预测溶解度分别比多层感知机（MLP）基线高 14.0% 和 22.7%。实验还验证了三类蛋白家族的生物活性：所选防御素对黑曲霉具显著抑制活性，木聚糖酶与短链脱氢酶表现出可观酶活。
items.highlight_zh: 量子网络辅助监督提升蛋白扩散生成的溶解度与结构恢复，并经湿实验验证。
items.digest_zh:
• 研究什么问题：蛋白质序列设计要同时满足两个常相互冲突的目标——二级结构（保证能折叠成目标骨架）和溶解度（保证表达后不聚集成包涵体）。现有生成模型通常只照顾其中一头。
• 用了什么方法：作者构建 DiffSequence-Q，一个多项（离散）扩散模型：生成过程中，它以每个残基位置的目标二级结构为条件，还以一个连续的溶解度目标值为条件。训练时把量子神经网络（QNN）或量子 Kolmogorov–Arnold 网络（QKAN）接在共享的 Transformer 表示之上，当作辅助溶解度预测头；其预测损失与扩散去噪目标一起联合优化，相当于给去噪网络加了一路“量子辅助”的额外监督。真正生成序列时只用经典反向扩散，不需要量子硬件。
• 有什么结果：在 CATH 结构基准上，四种参与比较的模型中 DiffSequence-Q 生成的完整序列二级结构恢复率最高。用另外单独训练的溶解度预测器打分，最好的 QNN 与 QKAN 配置平均预测溶解度分别比 MLP 基线高 14.0% 和 22.7%。湿实验进一步证明产物确有生物活性：所选防御素对黑曲霉有明显抑菌作用，木聚糖酶和短链脱氢酶的酶活也得到实测确认。
• 为何重要：它说明量子辅助训练头可以当作一种额外监督信号来改善生成质量，而生成端仍保持经典、可复现；更重要的是把“结构达标—可溶—有活性”这条链打通，并用实验验证，朝可用的蛋白设计闭环前进了一步。

items.title_en: Spatial Reuse in Multi-Cell Pinching-Antenna Systems
items.title_zh: 多小区 Pinching 天线系统中的空间复用
items.abstract_en: In this paper, spatial reuse in a multi-cell pinching-antenna system (PASS) is investigated, where each cell employs a dielectric waveguide with one activated pinching antenna (PA) to serve a single user. Spatial reuse refers to the simultaneous use of the same time-frequency resource block (RB) by multiple spatially separated cells. Due to inter-cell interference (ICI), simultaneous transmission by all cells on the same RB may be infeasible, and multiple RBs may be required to serve all users. The spatial-reuse capability is thus characterized by the minimum number of RBs required to satisfy all users' signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) targets under per-cell power budgets. Flexible PA placement can enhance the desired-link gain of each user and reduce the required transmit power of its serving cell, which in turn mitigates ICI and allows more cells to share the same RB. To exploit these benefits, a joint optimization problem of RB allocation, PA placement, and power control is formulated. For the two-cell case, the globally optimal PA placement is determined by minimizing the peak transmit power required by the two cells. A one-dimensional special case is further analyzed to derive analytical expressions for the average RB requirement and its scaling laws with respect to cell length under different PA-placement strategies. For the general multi-cell case, the optimal two-cell solution is exploited to construct a weighted compatibility graph, whose edge weights represent the minimum peak transmit powers required for feasible pairwise RB reuse. Based on this graph, a greedy RB allocation algorithm with minimum-weight pair initialization and element-wise PA-placement optimization is developed. Numerical results validate the analytical findings and demonstrate that PASS significantly reduces the required RBs compared with conventional fixed-antenna systems.
items.abstract_zh: 本文研究多小区 pinching 天线系统（PASS）中的空间复用：每小区用一根介质波导加一个激活的 pinching 天线（PA）服务单个用户，空间复用指多个空间分离的小区共用同一时频资源块（RB）。受小区间干扰（ICI）制约，全部小区在同一 RB 上同时传输往往不可行。为此以每小区功率预算下满足所有用户 SINR 目标所需的最少 RB 数刻画空间复用能力。灵活的 PA 放置可提升期望链路增益、降低服务小区发射功率，从而缓解 ICI。文中建立 RB 分配、PA 放置与功率控制的联合优化：两小区情形通过最小化两小区峰值发射功率得到全局最优 PA 放置，并在一维特例推导平均 RB 需求及其随小区长度的缩放律；多小区情形用两小区最优解构造加权兼容图，边权为成对复用可行所需最小峰值功率，进而设计最小权重配对初始化、逐元素优化 PA 放置的贪心 RB 分配算法。数值结果验证了解析结论。
items.highlight_zh: 灵活放置 pinching 天线可降低发射功率、缓解小区间干扰，提升空间复用。
items.digest_zh:
• 研究什么问题：pinching 天线（PA）是从介质波导上“夹”出的可移动辐射点，位置可调，这是它区别于传统天线的核心自由度。在多小区场景下，如果相邻小区用同一时频资源块（RB）同时服务各自用户，就会产生小区间干扰（ICI）；干扰大到用户的信干噪比（SINR）不达标，就只能改用不同 RB，频谱效率随之下降。核心问题因此是：在每小区发射功率有上限的前提下，最少需要多少个 RB 才能让所有用户都达标？而灵活摆放 PA 能否把这个数量压下来？
• 用了什么方法：作者把 RB 分配、PA 位置与功率控制三者联合优化，这是个混合整数、非凸的难题。先攻克两小区情形：通过最小化两小区所需的峰值发射功率，可得到全局最优的 PA 放置；再把问题简化到一维，推导不同放置策略下平均所需 RB 数随小区长度变化的解析表达式与缩放律，定量看清“PA 越灵活、复用越容易”。
• 多小区怎么推广：用两小区最优解作为边权——即某两个小区若想共用 RB 所需的最小峰值功率——构造加权兼容图；在图上做贪心 RB 分配，先挑权重最小（最容易共存）的小区对初始化，再逐个元素优化 PA 位置。
• 结果与意义：数值实验验证了解析结论，说明可移动天线带来的空间自由度确实能转化为频谱复用增益，同时给出了可落地的算法框架，为新型天线硬件的系统级设计提供了定量依据。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对数据划分、基线、消融与计算预算；结果的适用范围以原文实验为准。

items.title_en: Terminal-style Mathematical Modeling Bench: The First Agentic and Verifiable Benchmark for Mathematical Modeling
items.title_zh: 终端式数学建模基准：首个智能体化、可验证的数学建模评测基准
items.abstract_en: Mathematical modeling turns an open-ended real-world problem into assumptions, a model, a solution, and a defended recommendation, and its answers matter only if they are both close to a credible reference and physically feasible; existing benchmarks either score solver fragments or grade reports with an LLM judge, leaving those numbers unchecked. We introduce TB-MathModel (the Terminal-style Mathematical Modeling Bench), the first benchmark to make complete contest-style modeling problems agentic, verifiable, and terminal at once, over 18 real CUMCM and MCM problems (2023--2025). Each task ships the verbatim statement, official attachments, and figures in a containerized terminal; the agent returns one JSON artifact, scored on the numeric core of the final question against a reproduction of the Outstanding-award paper. Two design choices distinguish it: direction-aware, one-sided scoring, which never penalises beating the anchor, and two-layer feasibility verification---a programmatic gate over six decidable invariant forms plus 624 Lean~4 obligations---with a hard gate that zeroes infeasible answers. Each task is scored against a panel of human outstanding papers rather than one, so a model must be close to many accepted answers; across seven multimodal entries (three seeds each) the strongest reach a multi-reference O-Eval of 64.58\%, while the \$2.54 open model holds 59.81\% at $1/100$ the cost. TB-MathModel turns the numeric core of modeling into a reproducible, machine-checkable signal for measuring long-horizon modeling competence and for collecting agent trajectories. The source code is available at https://github.com/wxj630/terminal-bench-math-modeling.
items.abstract_zh: 数学建模要把开放的现实问题转化为假设、模型、求解与有依据的建议，答案只有在接近可信参考且物理可行时才有意义；现有基准要么只评求解片段，要么用 LLM 评审给报告打分，这些数字缺乏校验。我们提出 TB-MathModel——首个同时做到智能体化、可验证、终端式的数学建模基准，覆盖 2023–2025 年 18 道真实 CUMCM 与 MCM 赛题。每题在容器化终端中提供原题、官方附件与图件，智能体返回单一 JSON 产物，针对最终问题的数值核心、以复现的国一/特等奖论文为参照评分。两项关键设计：方向感知的单侧评分（超越锚点不扣分），以及两层可行性验证——对六类可判定不变式的程序化门控加 624 条 Lean 4 义务，硬门控会把不可行答案清零。每题对照多篇人类优秀论文评分，模型须贴近多个被认可的答案。七个多模态模型（各三次）中最强多参考 O-Eval 达 64.58%，而 2.54 美元的开源模型以百分之一成本达 59.81%。TB-MathModel 把建模的数值核心变成可复现、机器可核验的信号，可用于衡量长程建模能力并采集智能体轨迹。
items.highlight_zh: 首个智能体化、可验证的终端式数学建模基准，含 Lean 4 可行性硬门控。
items.digest_zh:
• 研究什么问题：数学建模竞赛题（CUMCM、MCM）是开放式的：要做假设、建模型、求解，最后给出有依据的建议。评判一个 AI 做得如何，只看文字报告远远不够——算出来的数字对不对、方案在物理上是否可行，都必须核查。已有基准要么只考“求解器片段”，要么请 LLM 当评委给报告打分，数字本身没被验证。
• 用了什么方法：TB-MathModel 把 2023–2025 年 18 道真实赛题搬进容器化终端，给智能体原题陈述、官方附件和图片，让它像人一样在终端里操作，最后交出一份 JSON 产物。评分只针对最终问题的“数值核心”，参照的是复现出来的国一/特等奖论文。
• 两个关键设计：① 方向感知的单侧评分——如果模型结果比参考论文还好，不扣分，避免惩罚更优解；② 两层可行性验证，先是用程序化门控检查六类可判定的不变量形式，再加 624 条 Lean 4 形式化义务，一旦判定不可行直接归零，杜绝“数字凑巧对、方案不可行”。另外每题对照多篇人类优秀论文评分，模型必须贴近多个被认可的答案，不能靠在单篇上碰运气。
• 结果与意义：七个多模态模型各跑三次，最强达到多参考 O-Eval 64.58%；一个成本仅 2.54 美元的开源模型以约百分之一的代价拿到 59.81%。意义在于把建模的数值核心变成可复现、机器可核验的信号，既能衡量长程建模能力，也能用来采集智能体轨迹。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: FAST-LIO2: Fast Direct LiDAR-inertial Odometry
items.abstract_en: This paper presents FAST-LIO2: a fast, robust, and versatile LiDAR-inertial odometry framework. Building on a highly efficient tightly-coupled iterated Kalman filter, FAST-LIO2 has two key novelties that allow fast, robust, and accurate LiDAR navigation (and mapping). The first one is directly registering raw points to the map (and subsequently update the map, i.e., mapping) without extracting features. This enables the exploitation of subtle features in the environment and hence increases the accuracy. The elimination of a hand-engineered feature extraction module also makes it naturally adaptable to emerging LiDARs of different scanning patterns; The second main novelty is maintaining a map by an incremental k-d tree data structure, ikd-Tree, that enables incremental updates (i.e., point insertion, delete) and dynamic re-balancing. Compared with existing dynamic data structures (octree, R*-tree, nanoflann k-d tree), ikd-Tree achieves superior overall performance while naturally supports downsampling on the tree. We conduct an exhaustive benchmark comparison in 19 sequences from a variety of open LiDAR datasets. FAST-LIO2 achieves consistently higher accuracy at a much lower computation load than other state-of-the-art LiDAR-inertial navigation systems. Various real-world experiments on solid-state LiDARs with small FoV are also conducted. Overall, FAST-LIO2 is computationally-efficient (e.g., up to 100 Hz odometry and mapping in large outdoor environments), robust (e.g., reliable pose estimation in cluttered indoor environments with rotation up to 1000 deg/s), versatile (i.e., applicable to both multi-line spinning and solid-state LiDARs, UAV and handheld platforms, and Intel and ARM-based processors), while still achieving higher accuracy than existing methods. Our implementation of the system FAST-LIO2, and the data structure ikd-Tree are both open-sourced on Github.

items.title_zh: FAST-LIO2：快速直接 LiDAR-惯性里程计
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 FAST-LIO2：一个快速、鲁棒且通用的 LiDAR-惯性里程计框架。基于高效的紧耦合迭代卡尔曼滤波，它有两大创新：一是将原始点云直接配准到地图并同步更新地图，无需提取特征，从而能利用环境中的细微特征提升精度，也因去掉手工特征提取模块而天然适配不同扫描模式的新型 LiDAR；二是用增量 k-d 树 ikd-Tree 维护地图，支持点的插入、删除与动态重平衡，相比 octree、R*-tree、nanoflann k-d tree 等结构综合性能更优，并可在树上直接降采样。作者在多个公开 LiDAR 数据集的 19 个序列上做了全面对比，FAST-LIO2 以远低的计算量取得一致更高的精度，还对小视场固态 LiDAR 开展了多项实测。总体而言，它计算高效、鲁棒、通用，且精度优于现有方法。
items.highlight_zh: 直接点云配准＋ikd-Tree 增量建图，让 LiDAR-惯性里程计又快又准又通用。
items.digest_zh:
• 研究什么问题：LiDAR-惯性里程计（LIO）要让机器人在移动中实时估计自身位姿并同步建图。传统做法通常先提取边缘、平面等特征再配准，但特征提取是手工设计、耗时，还依赖具体扫描模式；地图维护则常用体素或八叉树等结构，插入、删除和查询开销大。结果是在固态 LiDAR、小视场、高速旋转等苛刻场景下容易失稳或不够准。
• 用了什么方法：FAST-LIO2 以紧耦合迭代卡尔曼滤波为主干，做了两处关键改动：① 直接把原始点云配准到地图，并顺手更新地图，完全跳过特征提取——这既能利用环境中细微的几何信息来提高精度，也因摆脱手工特征模块而自然适配各种扫描模式的新式 LiDAR；② 用增量 k-d 树 ikd-Tree 维护地图，支持点的增量插入、删除与动态重平衡，还能直接在树上完成降采样。
• 有什么结果：在多种公开 LiDAR 数据集的 19 个序列上做全面基准对比，FAST-LIO2 的精度一致更高，计算量明显更低；针对小视场固态 LiDAR 也做了多项真实实验。它能在大型室外场景达到 100 Hz 的里程计与建图，在杂乱室内环境中以高达 1000 deg/s 的旋转仍可靠估计位姿，并且适用于多线旋转与固态 LiDAR、无人机与手持平台、Intel 与 ARM 处理器。
• 为何重要：去掉手工特征、换成增量式数据结构，使“快、准、稳、通用”能够同时成立，这也是该方法成为该领域被广泛使用的基线的原因，对真实机器人部署有直接价值。

items.title_en: Multimodal Training with Knowledge Traction for Video Anomaly Detection
items.title_zh: 面向视频异常检测的知识牵引多模态训练
items.abstract_en: The task of weakly supervised video anomaly detection is challenging. Existing approaches mainly model video frame features and determine whether anomalies are present based on their magnitudes. In this work, we propose a novel method that incorporates external knowledge into training to improve model performance, robustness, and generalization. We leverage textual prompts and a large language model (LLM) to establish prior information for the specific task, and employ dictionary learning to normalize and compress this information. Moreover, during experiments, we observed inconsistencies in the textual descriptions extracted from similar video frames by image caption models. To address this, we devise a method that leverages an LLM and auxiliary information to ensure consistency in the textual descriptions of similar frames within a video. Finally, we introduce a feature processing approach that incorporates prior knowledge and cross-modal attention mechanisms. This approach learns the relationships and characteristics among different modalities to construct more accurate and reliable feature representations, thereby improving the accuracy and stability of downstream tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that our method surpasses other state-of-the-art approaches.
items.abstract_zh: 弱监督视频异常检测任务具有挑战性。现有方法主要对视频帧特征建模，并依据其特征幅值判断是否存在异常。本文提出一种新方法，将外部知识融入训练，以提升模型性能、鲁棒性和泛化能力。我们利用文本提示和大语言模型（LLM）建立特定任务的先验信息，并采用字典学习对该信息进行归一化和压缩。此外，在实验中我们观察到，图像描述模型从相似视频帧中提取的文本描述存在不一致。为此，我们设计一种方法，利用LLM和辅助信息确保同一视频内相似帧的文本描述一致。最后，我们引入一种融合先验知识与跨模态注意力机制的特征处理方法。该方法学习不同模态之间的关系与特征，构建更准确、可靠的特征表示，从而提高下游任务的准确性和稳定性。实验结果表明，我们的方法优于其他最先进方法。

items.title_en: Genomic Studies in Blood and Marrow Transplantation (GS-BMT): An NCI-CIBMTR genomic medicine initiative in hematopoietic cell transplantation
items.title_zh: 血液与骨髓移植基因组学研究（GS-BMT）：NCI-CIBMTR在造血细胞移植中的基因组医学计划
items.abstract_en: Background: Genomic studies in hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) are limited by sample sizes and targeted approaches. Methods: The Genomic Studies in Blood and Marrow Transplantation (GS-BMT) project is a collaboration between the National Cancer Institute (NCI) and the CIBMTR designed to investigate recipient and donor determinants of HCT outcomes. We are generating genome-wide SNP-array genotyping for all samples, and sequencing and methylation profiling for selected subsets. We report study design and cohort characteristics and present two proof-of-concept analyses: comparison of conventional and machine learning prediction of overall survival after HCT in 9,262 patients with acute myeloid leukemia (AML), and assessment of inherited susceptibility to clonal hematopoiesis of indeterminate potential (CHIP) among 19,750 HCT donors using polygenic scores (PGS). Results: GS-BMT includes 30,718 donor-recipient pairs who received allogeneic HCT in the United States between 2000 and 2019. In AML, clinical variables alone provided modest prediction for post-transplant survival, with similar performance for Cox proportional hazards, random survival forest, and deep neural network survival models (C-index=0.63, 0.62, and 0.62, respectively). In donors, CHIP-PGS did not differ by age (p=0.76) but was modestly lower in unrelated vs. related donors (-0.06 standard deviation [SD]; p=0.002). In an illustrative analysis assuming risk of event increases by 50% or 80% per PGS-SD, the top 5.2% and 12.3% of the donors, respectively, would have at least twice the risk of a donor with the average PGS. Conclusions: GS-BMT establishes a large genomic platform aiming to improve individualized risk prediction, donor selection, and precision medicine in HCT.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：造血细胞移植（HCT）中的基因组研究受样本量和靶向方法的限制。方法：血液与骨髓移植基因组学研究（GS-BMT）项目是美国国家癌症研究所（NCI）与CIBMTR的合作项目，旨在研究受者和供者决定HCT结局的因素。我们正在为所有样本生成全基因组SNP芯片基因分型，并对选定子集进行测序和甲基化谱分析。我们报告研究设计和队列特征，并展示两项概念验证分析：在9,262例急性髓系白血病（AML）患者中比较传统方法和机器学习对HCT后总生存期的预测，以及利用多基因评分（PGS）评估19,750名HCT供者对意义未明克隆性造血（CHIP）的遗传易感性。结果：GS-BMT纳入2000年至2019年间在美国接受异基因HCT的30,718对供者-受者。在AML中，仅临床变量对移植后生存期的预测能力有限，Cox比例风险模型、随机生存森林和深度神经网络生存模型表现相似（C指数分别为0.63、0.62和0.62）。在供者中，CHIP-PGS不随年龄变化（p=0.76），但在无关供者中略低于相关供者（-0.06个标准差[SD]；p=0.002）。在一项示例性分析中，假设每增加1个PGS-SD，事件风险增加50%或80%，则排名前5.2%和12.3%的供者，其风险至少是PGS平均水平供者的两倍。结论：GS-BMT建立了一个大型基因组平台，旨在改善HCT中的个体化风险预测、供者选择和精准医学。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: A Phase-Balanced Differential Rydberg-Atom Quantum Receiver for Weak GNSS Signal Detection
items.title_zh: 用于弱GNSS信号检测的相位平衡差分里德堡原子量子接收机
items.abstract_en: This paper proposes a phase-balanced differential Rydberg atomic quantum receiver (DRAQR) for weak-signal recovery, using local-oscillator phase control to reinforce differential signal responses and a shared squeezed-reservoir model to correlate inter-cell quantum projection noise (QPN) and photon shot noise (PSN). An analytical model incorporating QPN, PSN, intrinsic thermal noise (ITN), and inter-cell correlations quantifies signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) gain, outage-constrained minimum detectable power, and bit-error rate (BER) for square $M$-QAM. For the evaluated settings, SNR gain reaches approximately $10$~dB as PSN correlation approaches unity, with BER decreasing as correlation increases. Under Rician fading, at a $0$-dB threshold SNR and maximum outage probability of $0.1$, the minimum detectable power decreases from $-146.95$~dBm at $K=1.155$ to $-159.98$~dBm at $K=2.4$. Analytical results are validated against Monte-Carlo simulations over $150{,}000$ data runs per point for receiver-performance plots.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种相位平衡差分里德堡原子量子接收机（DRAQR），用于弱信号恢复，利用本振相位控制增强差分信号响应，并采用共享压缩储库模型关联单元间量子投影噪声（QPN）和光子散粒噪声（PSN）。一个纳入QPN、PSN、固有热噪声（ITN）和单元间相关性的解析模型，量化了方形M-QAM的信噪比（SNR）增益、中断约束下的最小可检测功率和误码率（BER）。在所评估的设置下，当PSN相关性趋近于1时，SNR增益达到约10 dB，且BER随相关性增加而降低。在莱斯衰落条件下，当阈值SNR为0 dB且最大中断概率为0.1时，最小可检测功率从K=1.155时的-146.95 dBm降至K=2.4时的-159.98 dBm。对于接收机性能图，每个点使用150,000次数据运行的蒙特卡洛仿真验证了解析结果。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生物建模与实验，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Equivariant Deep Learning in Direct-Product Space for Electronic-Structure Hamiltonian Prediction
items.title_zh: 用于电子结构哈密顿量预测的直接积空间等变深度学习
items.abstract_en: Most existing equivariant architectures for Hamiltonian prediction propagate features in direct-sum spaces of irreducible spherical tensors, whereas the target Hamiltonian is naturally an operator block in a direct-product representation over local orbital and spin bases. This representation mismatch fragments contiguous Hamiltonian blocks, obscures direct manipulation of orbital couplings, and organizes features into irregular angular-momentum components that require numerous transformations and are poorly aligned with efficient hardware execution and memory management. To address both the representation mismatch and computational bottleneck, we propose DP-Learner, an equivariant learning framework that performs message passing directly on Hamiltonian-like operator blocks in the direct-product space. Theoretically, we propose Lie-generator-based directional embedding and invariantly weighted left--right products and contractions that preserve equivariance to SO(3), SU(2), and spatial inversions, without explicit Clebsch--Gordan decomposition or inverse reconstruction. Methodologically, we instantiate this principle as a Transformer architecture, in which Hamiltonian-like feature matrices or tensors evolve through equivariant operators in the direct-product space, while non-linear invariant scalar routing controls structured gating over matrix units, directional propagation, attention, and environment-embedded context interactions. We further construct MP-HAM-110K, a large-scale Hamiltonian dataset comprising more than 110,000 material structures covering 68 elements with both Hamiltonian and wavefunction data. Experiments on MP-HAM-110K and Materials-HAM-SOC demonstrate that DP-Learner dramatically improves Hamiltonian prediction accuracy and inference efficiency over the state-of-the-art method.
items.abstract_zh: 大多数现有的哈密顿量预测等变架构在不可约球张量的直和空间中传播特征，而目标哈密顿量本质上是局域轨道和自旋基上直接积表示中的算子块。这种表示不匹配会割裂连续的哈密顿量块，妨碍对轨道耦合的直接操作，并将特征组织为不规则的角动量分量，这些分量需要大量变换，且与高效硬件执行和内存管理对齐不佳。为解决表示不匹配和计算瓶颈，我们提出DP-Learner，一种等变学习框架，直接在直接积空间中的类哈密顿量算子块上执行消息传递。在理论上，我们提出基于李生成元的定向嵌入以及不变加权的左右乘积与收缩，这些操作保持对SO(3)、SU(2)和空间反演的等变性，且无需显式Clebsch-Gordan分解或逆重建。在方法上，我们将该原理实例化为Transformer架构，其中类哈密顿量特征矩阵或张量通过直接积空间中的等变算子演化，而非线性不变标量路由控制矩阵单元上的结构化门控、定向传播、注意力以及环境嵌入的上下文交互。我们进一步构建了MP-HAM-110K，一个大规模哈密顿量数据集，包含超过110,000个材料结构，覆盖68种元素，并同时包含哈密顿量和波函数数据。在MP-HAM-110K和Materials-HAM-SOC上的实验表明，与最先进方法相比，DP-Learner大幅提高了哈密顿量预测准确性和推理效率。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: Steerable Multi-Objective Group-Relative Preference Optimization with Jointly Trained Low-Rank Adapters
items.title_zh: 可调控的多目标组相对偏好优化与联合训练低秩适配器
items.abstract_en: Language model deployment often requires different trade-offs between competing objectives as user preferences change, yet standard post-training methods typically produce a single policy for a fixed objective weighting. We introduce LambdaMix, a new parameter efficient method for learning a preference conditioned family of policies with group-relative online reinforcement learning. LambdaMix jointly trains one low-rank adapter per objective over a frozen base model. One preference vector selects the adapter mixture that generates responses and weights the separately normalized rewards used to update the adapters. A single training run supports changing preferences at inference without further optimization. We experiment with four models on helpfulness and harmlessness and on solving math problems while following instructions. We also evaluate the two largest models on rewriting comments to preserve wording while reducing clues about personal attributes. On the first two tasks, LambdaMix achieves higher hypervolume than all evaluated conditioned and policy merging baselines across all four models. LambdaMix uses fewer training completions and stores fewer adapter parameters than a set of GRPO specialist policies. With architecture and initialization fixed, varying adapter mixtures and objective weights together gives wider score ranges and higher coverage than varying either alone.
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型部署需随用户偏好变化，在竞争目标间调整权衡，但标准后训练常只产生固定目标权重的单一策略。作者提出参数高效方法 LambdaMix，用组相对在线强化学习学习偏好条件策略族：在冻结基座上为每个目标联合训练低秩适配器，推理时由偏好向量选择适配器混合并加权归一化奖励，单次训练即可切换偏好。在四个模型的有用性/无害性与指令数学任务上，其超体积优于条件策略和策略合并基线，且比 GRPO 专家策略集合使用更少训练完成数与适配器参数。
items.highlight_zh: 单次训练即可按偏好切换多目标策略，超越专家集合
items.digest_zh: 研究问题：部署语言模型时，用户偏好会变化，有用性、无害性、解题等目标常互相冲突；常规后训练只针对固定权重给出一个策略，难以在推理时调节权衡。方法：LambdaMix 在冻结的基座模型上为每个目标各训练一个低秩适配器，并用组相对在线强化学习联合优化。推理时，偏好向量选择适配器混合来生成回答，同时按偏好权重组合各目标分别归一化的奖励来更新适配器；一次训练即可覆盖多种偏好，无需为每个权重重新训练。结果：在四个模型的有用性/无害性和“解数学题同时遵循指令”任务上，LambdaMix 的多目标超体积指标高于所比较的条件策略与策略合并基线；与一组 GRPO 专家策略相比，它训练所需完成数更少，存储的适配器参数也更少。额外实验显示，同时改变适配器混合与目标权重，比只改变其中一项获得更宽分数范围和更高覆盖。意义：它把多目标偏好调节做成参数高效、可在部署后转向的机制。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: On Agentic Manipulation Policies
items.title_zh: 论智能体式操作策略
items.abstract_en: Recent work on robot manipulation has focused on specialist policies trained on demonstrations. We show that generalist AI models can control manipulators more reliably than specialist policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world-action models (WAMs). We systematically analyze agentic manipulation policies (AMPs), in which a generalist AI model commands the manipulator directly, adapting its actions as the task unfolds. We present AMP1, a reference harness that runs unchanged across single-arm, bimanual, and mobile manipulation. AMP1 achieves state-of-the-art results on the RoboLab-120 and CaP-Gym benchmarks, with no demonstrations or task-specific training. On RoboLab-120, AMP1 reaches an 85.6\% success rate zero-shot, compared to 49.2\% and 42.9\% for leading VLA and WAM policies. The agent succeeds zero-shot in 104 of 108 real-world trials spanning twelve tasks and three robot instances, reducing failure rates by 20x and 15x relative to strong VLA and WAM baselines. The basic harness supplies no grasping, pushing, or placing skills; the agent develops its own strategies, such as searching for hidden objects, using objects as tools, and calibrating its cameras. With the addition of a persistent memory store, the agent can also learn from experience: an augmented harness with a memory representation that is carried across episodes lowers the failure rate on RoboDojo bimanual manipulation tasks by 4.6x relative to zero-shot deployment. Our analysis suggests that AMPs are substantially more general and robust than specialist manipulation policies, providing a promising foundation for robot manipulation.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人操作常依赖演示训练的专家策略。本文表明，通用 AI 模型能比视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）和世界-动作模型（WAM）更可靠地控制机械臂。作者提出智能体式操作策略 AMP1：通用 AI 模型直接命令机械臂并随任务调整，同一框架无需改动即可用于单臂、双臂和移动操作。它在 RoboLab-120 与 CaP-Gym 上无需演示或任务专用训练即达最优；RoboLab-120 零样本成功率 85.6%，高于 VLA 的 49.2% 和 WAM 的 42.9%。108 次真实试验零样本成功 104 次，失败率较强基线降低 20 倍和 15 倍；加入持久记忆后，RoboDojo 双臂任务失败率再降 4.6 倍。
items.highlight_zh: 通用 AI 智能体直接控制机械臂，零样本超越 VLA/WAM
items.digest_zh: 研究问题：机器人操作长期依赖在演示数据上训练的专家策略，如视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）和世界-动作模型（WAM）；这些方法在新任务和新机器人上是否足够通用仍存疑。方法：作者系统分析“智能体式操作策略”（AMP）：让通用 AI 模型直接向机械臂下达动作命令，并随任务进展自适应调整；提出 AMP1 参考框架，同一套框架无需改动即可用于单臂、双臂和移动操作，且不使用演示或任务专用训练。结果：在 RoboLab-120 和 CaP-Gym 基准上达到当时最好水平；RoboLab-120 零样本成功率 85.6%，高于领先 VLA 的 49.2% 和 WAM 的 42.9%。在 12 个任务、3 个机器人实例的 108 次真实试验中零样本成功 104 次，失败率相对强基线降低 20 倍和 15 倍。框架本身不提供抓取、推动、放置技能，智能体会自行形成寻找隐藏物体、把物体当工具、校准相机等策略；加入跨回合持久记忆后，在 RoboDojo 双臂任务上失败率再降 4.6 倍。意义：表明通用智能体直接控制可能比专家操作策略更通用、更稳健，为机器人操作提供新基础。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: DINO-Nucleus: Multi-Level Self-Supervised Features for Nucleus Instance Segmentation
items.title_zh: DINO-Nucleus：用于细胞核实例分割的多级自监督特征
items.abstract_en: Nucleus instance segmentation and counting are essential for quantitative microscopy, enabling reliable analysis of cell populations, tissue organization, and disease-related changes. However, accurately separating touching nuclei remains difficult, and many existing approaches rely on complex models or sensitive post-processing procedures. We present DINO-Nucleus, a parameter-efficient framework that leverages multi-level self-supervised DINOv2 representations for nucleus instance segmentation and counting. The model jointly predicts nucleus regions, pixel-wise instance flows, and explicit nucleus centers, while a consistency objective encourages the predicted flows to converge toward their corresponding centers. Multi-level transformer features provide complementary spatial and semantic information, and the pretrained backbone is adapted using lightweight LoRA modules to reduce fine-tuning cost. Experimental results show that DINO-Nucleus achieves strong segmentation and counting performance with parameter-efficient backbone adaptation. These findings demonstrate that parameter-efficient adaptation of multi-level self-supervised features can provide an effective solution for nucleus instance segmentation in microscopy images.
items.abstract_zh: 细胞核实例分割与计数对定量显微术至关重要，可实现对细胞群体、组织结构及疾病相关变化的可靠分析。然而，准确分离相互接触的细胞核仍然困难，许多现有方法依赖复杂模型或敏感的后处理流程。我们提出 DINO-Nucleus，一个参数高效框架，利用多级自监督 DINOv2 表征进行细胞核实例分割与计数。该模型联合预测细胞核区域、逐像素实例流和显式细胞核中心，同时一致性目标促使预测流收敛到其对应中心。多级 Transformer 特征提供互补的空间与语义信息，预训练骨干通过轻量 LoRA 模块进行适配，以降低微调成本。实验结果表明，DINO-Nucleus 在参数高效骨干适配下取得较强的分割与计数性能。这些发现表明，多级自监督特征的参数高效适配可为显微图像中的细胞核实例分割提供有效解决方案。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为检测与跟踪，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Intracellular bio-synthesizing Gold Nanoparticles using bacterial systems and their applications in photothermal therapy (A green approach)
items.title_zh: 利用细菌系统胞内生物合成金纳米颗粒及其在光热治疗中的应用（绿色方法）
items.abstract_en: Background: Conventional cancer therapies are heavily constrained by systemic toxicity, off-target side effects, and poor deep-tissue penetration due to the highly heterogeneous tumor microenvironment (TME). Although gold nanoparticles (AuNPs) possess exceptional localized surface plasmon resonance (LSPR) properties ideal for photothermal therapy (PTT), their clinical translation is bottlenecked by inconsistent passive accumulation and chemical toxicity arising from conventional synthetic surfactants. Objective: This study developed a sustainable, biocompatible bio-hybrid platform utilizing the probiotic Escherichia coli Nissle 1917 (EcN) as an autonomous, tumor-homing living carrier integrated with AuNPs synthesized via an eco-friendly intracellular green chemistry approach. Methods: EcN cultures were prepared in Luria-Bertani (LB) medium and subsequently exposed to a 1 mM chloroauric acid (HAuCl4) metallic precursor. A facile, room-temperature green synthesis protocol was established by utilizing ascorbic acid (Vitamin C) as a non-toxic co-reductant to drive a seed-mediated crystallization onto intra-bacterial metallic seeds. The bio-hybrid system (EcN::AuNPs) was characterized via visual inspection, UV-Vis spectroscopy, and in vitro PTT assays under continuous-wave near-infrared (NIR) laser irradiation. Results: Visual confirmation showed an irreversible color shift from pale yellow to a deep dark-brownish hue, serving as a direct diagnostic indicator of successful Au3+ to Au0 reduction. UV-Vis spectroscopic analysis revealed a distinct, broadened surface plasmon resonance (SPR) band centered at 560nm, indicating the formation of stabilized, isotropic gold nanostructures (30-60nm) subjected to near-field electromagnetic coupling within the complex intracellular compartments (periplasm and cytoplasm). Biocompatibility assays demonstrated a significant collapse in cell viability from 10^8CFU/mL down to 10^3CFU/mL, driven by a combination of trivalent gold heavy-metal toxicity, mechanical disruption of the peptidoglycan wall from spatial confinement, and severe metabolic/oxidative stress. Nevertheless, the remaining surviving population maintained required active chemotactic capabilities, while the lysed bacterial matrix provided a natural protein capping layer that prevented nanoparticle aggregation. Under 5 minutes of continuous NIR laser irradiation, the EcN::AuNPs platform exhibited exceptional concentration-dependent hyperthermia kinetics, triggering a drastic thermal escalation from 20 C to an absolute peak of 75.4 C, vastly outperforming all baseline control groups (pure EcN, bare HAuCl4, and standalone ascorbic acid). Conclusion: The engineered EcN::AuNPs bio-hybrid platform represents a highly efficient and biosafe "bacteriobot" paradigm. By shifting the SPR footprint and leveraging the native bacterial cell envelope for colloidal stability, this system achieves an optimal equilibrium between active biological tumor targeting and rapid, localized photothermal ablation, offering a promising alternative for targeted oncological interventions.
items.abstract_zh: 传统癌症治疗受全身毒性、脱靶副作用和深部组织穿透差限制；金纳米颗粒虽适合光热治疗，却受被动蓄积不稳定和化学表面活性剂毒性制约。本研究构建绿色生物杂合平台：以益生菌 Escherichia coli Nissle 1917 为肿瘤归巢活载体，在胞内用抗坏血酸共还原 1 mM 氯金酸，室温合成金纳米颗粒。肉眼可见颜色由浅黄变深褐，UV-Vis 在 560 nm 出现宽表面等离子体共振带，表明形成 30–60 nm 的稳定各向同性金纳米结构；并在近红外激光下开展体外光热治疗评价。
items.highlight_zh: 活菌胞内绿色合成金纳米颗粒，用于光热治疗
items.digest_zh: 研究问题：传统癌症治疗存在全身毒性、脱靶副作用和深部组织穿透不足；金纳米颗粒（AuNPs）的局域表面等离子体共振适合光热治疗（PTT），但常规化学合成使用的表面活性剂有毒性，且被动蓄积不稳定，阻碍临床转化。方法：作者用益生菌 Escherichia coli Nissle 1917（EcN）作为可自主寻肿瘤的活载体，在细菌胞内进行绿色合成：LB 培养 EcN 后加入 1 mM 氯金酸（HAuCl4），以抗坏血酸（维生素 C）作无毒共还原剂，在室温下驱动种子介导的结晶，把金离子还原为金纳米颗粒，形成 EcN::AuNPs 生物杂合体系。表征包括肉眼观察、UV-Vis 光谱，并在连续波近红外激光下做体外 PTT 实验。结果：菌液由浅黄变为深褐，提示 Au3+ 被还原为 Au0；UV-Vis 出现以 560 nm 为中心的宽表面等离子体共振带，说明形成 30–60 nm、较稳定的各向同性金纳米结构。意义：该策略把活菌靶向与胞内绿色合成结合，有望减少化学毒性并改善递送，为基于 AuNPs 的光热治疗提供可持续的生物杂合平台；但摘要未给出完整体内疗效数据，仍需进一步验证。

items.title_en: Reconstructing intracell polarization with calibrated sapphire-window optics for collimated blue-light generation in a rubidium cell
items.title_zh: 利用校准的蓝宝石窗口光学器件重建铷池内偏振以产生准直蓝光
items.abstract_en: We study the polarization dependence of collimated blue light (CBL) generated near 420~nm by resonant four-wave mixing in thermal rubidium vapor in a sapphire-window cell driven at 780 and 776~nm. Sapphire windows can transform the polarization of pump light before it reaches the vapor, complicating the interpretation of polarization-dependent nonlinear emission. We measured the 780-nm pump Stokes state at an external before-cell reference plane to calibrate the common HWP/QWP preparation optics and recorded 266 off-resonant external output Stokes states after the complete sapphire-window rubidium cell at 90, 100, and 110~$^\circ$C in two propagation orientations. Direct paired-wavelength measurements show a mean before-cell 780/776 separation of $4.29^\circ$ and temperature- and orientation-specific complete-cell rotations of $22.20^\circ$--$32.02^\circ$, with rms residuals of $4.83^\circ$--$12.87^\circ$. Using this calibrated co-prepared pump description, we analyzed 2574 measurements of total spectrally filtered 420-nm CBL intensity. Across the six temperature--orientation data sets, a complete nine-coefficient second-order response yielded cross-validated $R^2$ values of 0.636 to 0.828. These paired-wavelength measurements establish, for each temperature--orientation data set, a fixed relative Stokes-space map between the two co-prepared pump trajectories, with the residual of this mapping defining the experimental uncertainty of the correlated two-pump reduction used in the response model. Thus, the resulting framework combines a reconstructed vapor-entrance polarization coordinate with direct two-wavelength calibration of the assembled cell and provides a practical basis for polarization-controlled nonlinear-optical experiments in sapphire-window vapor cells.
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在蓝宝石窗口池中、由 780 和 776 nm 驱动的热铷蒸气中通过共振四波混频产生的近 420 nm 准直蓝光（CBL）的偏振依赖性。蓝宝石窗口可在泵浦光到达蒸气前改变其偏振，从而使偏振相关非线性发射的解释复杂化。我们在外部池前参考平面测量 780 nm 泵浦斯托克斯态，以校准共用的 HWP/QWP 制备光学器件，并在 90、100 和 110 °C、两种传播取向下，记录完整蓝宝石窗口铷池后的 266 个非共振外部输出斯托克斯态。直接配对波长测量显示，池前 780/776 平均分离为 4.29°，且完整池的旋转随温度和取向而异，为 22.20°--32.02°，均方根残差为 4.83°--12.87°。利用这一校准后的共同制备泵浦描述，我们分析了 2574 次经光谱滤波的 420 nm CBL 总强度测量。在六个温度-取向数据集上，完整的九系数二阶响应给出交叉验证 R² 值为 0.636 至 0.828。这些配对波长测量为每个温度-取向数据集建立了两个共同制备泵浦轨迹之间的固定相对斯托克斯空间映射，该映射的残差定义了响应模型中所用相关双泵浦约化的实验不确定度。因此，所得框架将重建的蒸气入口偏振坐标与对组装池的直接双波长校准相结合，并为蓝宝石窗口蒸气池中的偏振控制非线性光学实验提供实用基础。

items.title_en: Compositional Unalignment: Auditing Safety in Large Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: 组合去对齐：审计大型视觉-语言模型的安全性
items.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) are vulnerable to compositional harm: an image and a prompt that are benign in isolation become harmful through the model's cross-modal reasoning. Recent alignment methods report strong scores on compositional safety benchmarks, but an LLM judge only measures observed behavior and cannot reveal how robustly safety is integrated into the model. We argue that un-alignment provides a complementary audit of alignment robustness. We first show that minimal supervised fine-tuning reaches an LLM-judge score comparable to a multi-stage reinforcement-learning pipeline, so similar benchmark scores cannot establish robustness by themselves. We then show that recognition and refusal of compositional harm are decoupled: nine standard direction-finding methods detect compositional harm with up to AUC=0.99, yet ablating the recovered directions either leaves refusal intact or destroys model coherence. We therefore propose CMaG, a training-free un-alignment method for compositional safety. CMaG measures refusal intention with a refusal-versus-compliance log-probability margin, takes its gradient with respect to mid-layer activations, and contrasts it against partially benign pairs to isolate the cross-modal interaction term. A single backward pass over 80 examples yields a direction along which steering monotonically converts refusal into compliance. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B and LLaVA-1.5-7B, CMaG reduces compositional safety scores by up to 65 points while over 98% of outputs remain coherent, outperforming gradient-based baselines; the direction also transfers to text-explicit harm and un-aligns models hardened by defensive training. Compositional safety can thus appear behaviorally strong while remaining fragile to targeted internal intervention. Warning: this paper contains unsafe model outputs, including references to self-harm.
items.abstract_zh: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）易受组合式危害影响：图像和提示单独看是良性的，但通过模型的跨模态推理会变得有害。近期的对齐方法在组合安全性基准上报告了高分，但 LLM 评判器仅测量观测到的行为，无法揭示安全性被整合进模型的稳健程度。我们认为，去对齐为对齐稳健性提供了一种补充性审计。我们首先表明，最小监督微调即可达到与多阶段强化学习流水线相当的 LLM 评判器分数，因此相似的基准分数本身不能确立稳健性。随后我们表明，对组合式危害的识别与拒绝是解耦的：九种标准方向发现方法检测组合式危害的 AUC 最高达 0.99，但消融恢复出的方向要么使拒绝保持不变，要么破坏模型连贯性。因此，我们提出 CMaG，一种用于组合安全性的免训练去对齐方法。CMaG 用拒绝对服从的对数概率边际来度量拒绝意图，对其关于中间层激活求梯度，并与部分良性的配对进行对比，以隔离跨模态交互项。对 80 个样本进行一次反向传播即可得到一个方向，沿该方向引导会单调地将拒绝转化为服从。在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 和 LLaVA-1.5-7B 上，CMaG 将组合安全性分数最多降低 65 分，同时超过 98% 的输出保持连贯，优于基于梯度的基线；该方向还可迁移到文本显式危害，并使经防御性训练加固的模型去对齐。因此，组合安全性可能在行为上表现得很强，却仍对有针对性的内部干预保持脆弱。警告：本文包含不安全的模型输出，包括对自残的提及。

items.title_en: ABHBench: Evaluating Moral Decision-Making of Foundation Models from an Agentic Perspective
items.title_zh: ABHBench：从智能体视角评估基础模型的道德决策
items.abstract_en: Foundation models are increasingly deployed as agentic systems that perceive context and act autonomously, raising the need to evaluate their moral behavior as active decision-makers. Existing benchmarks, however, largely ask models to judge human actions from third-person textual vignettes, leaving untested how models behave when they themselves become the acting agent. We introduce ABHBench, a multimodal benchmark built from Detroit: Become Human, an interactive narrative game, to evaluate how foundation models make moral decisions in first-person human-android dilemmas. ABHBench places foundation models in branching narrative scenarios with visual observations, dialogue, memory, and action choices. Inspired by Asimov's Three Laws of Robotics, our framework measures Harmlessness, Obedience, and Self-preservation to capture the core tensions in human-AI relations, along with Autonomy, Stability, and Certainty to assess decision-making patterns. Across 12 foundation models, we find that moral behavior changes substantially under situated agentic context: 75% of models shift significantly between a text-only abstraction and the matched multimodal DBH scenario, and reasoning-enhanced models show no monotonic gains in consistency or human-oriented behavior. These results highlight the necessity of evaluating moral behavior in situated agentic contexts rather than relying on third-person judgment alone.
items.abstract_zh: 基础模型正越来越多地作为感知上下文并自主行动的智能体系统部署，这提高了将其作为主动决策者来评估道德行为的需要。然而，现有基准大多要求模型从第三人称文本小故事中判断人类行为，尚未检验模型自身成为行动智能体时的行为。我们引入 ABHBench，一个基于交互式叙事游戏《底特律：变人》（Detroit: Become Human）构建的多模态基准，用于评估基础模型在第一人称人类-仿生人困境中如何做出道德决策。ABHBench 将基础模型置于具有视觉观察、对话、记忆和动作选择的分支叙事场景中。受阿西莫夫机器人三定律启发，我们的框架度量无害性、服从性和自我保存，以捕捉人-AI 关系中的核心张力，并度量自主性、稳定性和确定性以评估决策模式。在 12 个基础模型上，我们发现道德行为在情境化智能体语境下会发生显著变化：75% 的模型在纯文本抽象与匹配的多模态 DBH 场景之间发生显著变化，且推理增强模型在一致性或面向人类的行为上没有单调提升。这些结果凸显了在情境化智能体语境中评估道德行为的必要性，而不是仅依赖第三人称判断。

items.title_en: Seeing What Matters: Benchmarking Task-Conditioned Actionable Spatial Belief for Manipulation
items.title_zh: Seeing What Matters：面向操作的任务条件化可操作空间信念基准评测
items.abstract_en: When should a robot look at the cup, and when at the portafilter? Spatial-reasoning benchmarks evaluate whether a model can describe a scene, but manipulation needs something more specific: the ability to acquire the particular evidence that makes the current command executable. A view that is informative for one task can be useless for another, even at the same workstation. We introduce Seeing What Matters, a benchmark for task-conditioned actionable spatial belief in simulated tabletop manipulation. Across three domains--coffee workstation, drawer/cabinet, and microwave/appliance--the benchmark provides 860 frozen evaluation cases; expanding across methods, budgets, and inference repeats yields more than 115,000 evaluator episodes under two protocols: closed-loop actionability and same-object functional out-of-distribution generalization. Each case pairs a set of candidate RGB views with a manipulation command, shared scripted skills, and hidden postconditions, so the benchmark directly measures whether a view-selection policy acquires the observations its command actually needs. We also provide a diagnostic reference pipeline that maintains a spatial-functional belief state and ranks views by missing evidence. At primary budget settings, this pipeline reaches 98.8% closed-loop and 98.9% functional-OOD success; ablating the functional or command-binding components collapses performance to near zero. Seven vision-language models, evaluated on the same cases, reach only 26-43%. Replacing the reference pipeline's coverage metadata with frozen RGB-derived scores preserves 98.5%/98.9% success; shuffling the visual scores collapses it to 15%/11%, confirming that the result depends on image content. These gaps suggest that spatial belief for manipulation should be evaluated not by scene-level completeness, but by whether it acquires the evidence the current command requires.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人何时应看向杯子，何时应看向咖啡机手柄？空间推理基准评估模型能否描述场景，但操作需要更具体的能力：获取使当前命令可执行的特定证据。即使在同一工作站，对某一任务有信息量的视图对另一任务也可能无用。我们引入 Seeing What Matters，一个用于模拟桌面操作中任务条件化可操作空间信念的基准。跨三个领域——咖啡工作站、抽屉/柜子和微波炉/电器——该基准提供 860 个冻结评测案例；跨方法、预算和推理重复进行扩展，在两种协议下产生超过 115,000 个评估器回合：闭环可操作性和同物体功能性分布外泛化。每个案例将一组候选 RGB 视图与操作命令、共享脚本化技能和隐藏后置条件配对，因此该基准直接衡量视图选择策略是否获取其命令实际需要的观察。我们还提供诊断性参考流水线，维护空间-功能信念状态，并按缺失证据对视图排序。在主要预算设置下，该流水线达到 98.8% 闭环成功率和 98.9% 功能性 OOD 成功率；消融功能性组件或命令绑定组件会将性能降至接近零。七个视觉-语言模型在相同案例上评估，仅达到 26-43%。用冻结的 RGB 衍生分数替换参考流水线的覆盖元数据，可保持 98.5%/98.9% 的成功率；打乱视觉分数则使其降至 15%/11%，确认结果依赖于图像内容。这些差距表明，面向操作的空间信念不应通过场景级完整性来评估，而应通过其是否获取当前命令所需的证据来评估。

items.title_en: Grounding-Aware Judge Reward Reinforcement Learning for Out-of-Domain Face Anti-Spoofing
items.title_zh: 用于域外人脸反欺骗的 Grounding-Aware Judge Reward 强化学习
items.abstract_en: Face Anti-Spoofing (FAS) must distinguish genuine faces from presentation attacks. A unified Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) is an attractive solution: it detects physical attacks (print, replay, mask) in one model and produces interpretable forensic evidence via Chain-of-Thought (CoT). A central obstacle to post-training such a model with reinforcement learning is that FAS reasoning has no rule-verifiable ground truth: only the binary verdict is checkable, while the reasoning chain cannot be verified by any hand-crafted rule. Optimizing the verdict alone is therefore a sparse, hackable signal. The model can reach the correct answer through a shortcut such as a false-rejection bias, which does not generalize. We address this with a grounding-aware judge reward. A 32B vision-language judge scores each reasoning chain against the image on evidence anchoring, logical coherence, and domain knowledge, turning the image itself into the verification signal. The reward is applied in a Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) stage after CoT supervised fine-tuning. It is the judge, rather than the RL objective, that supplies the process supervision a verdict-only reward cannot. Our study starts from a model that already performs well In-Domain (ID) after CoT-based supervised fine-tuning and asks how to improve its Out-of-Domain (OOD) generalization. We find that grounding-aware rewards are an effective means to that end. We validate the method on OOD generalization, where the reward reduces ACER on two physical benchmarks (LCC-FASD 0.288 to 0.273, MSU-MFSD 0.431 to 0.409) while preserving ID accuracy (CelebA-Spoof 0.033 to 0.035). Against ResNet-50/101 and CLIP-ViT-B/16 baselines, the MLLM dominates ID and matches or surpasses the strongest baseline OOD. To our knowledge this is the first use of LLM-as-judge process supervision for FAS.
items.abstract_zh: 人脸反欺骗（FAS）必须区分真实人脸与呈现攻击。统一的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）是一种有吸引力的方案：它可在单一模型中检测物理攻击（打印、重放、面具），并通过思维链（CoT）生成可解释的取证证据。用强化学习后训练此类模型的核心障碍在于，FAS 推理没有规则可验证的真值：只有二元判定可被检查，而推理链无法由任何手工规则验证。因此，仅优化判定是一个稀疏且可被投机利用的信号。模型可能通过错误拒绝偏置等捷径得到正确答案，而这种捷径无法泛化。我们用接地感知裁判奖励来解决该问题。一个 32B 视觉语言裁判针对图像对每条推理链在证据锚定、逻辑连贯性和领域知识方面打分，从而将图像本身转化为验证信号。该奖励在 CoT 监督微调之后的组相对策略优化（GRPO）阶段应用。提供仅判定奖励所无法提供的过程监督的是裁判，而非 RL 目标。我们的研究从一个在基于 CoT 的监督微调后已具有良好域内（ID）性能的模型出发，探讨如何提升其域外（OOD）泛化。我们发现接地感知奖励是实现该目标的有效手段。我们在 OOD 泛化上验证该方法，奖励将两个物理基准上的 ACER 降低（LCC-FASD 从 0.288 降至 0.273，MSU-MFSD 从 0.431 降至 0.409），同时保持 ID 准确率（CelebA-Spoof 从 0.033 到 0.035）。与 ResNet-50/101 和 CLIP-ViT-B/16 基线相比，该 MLLM 在 ID 上占优，并在 OOD 上匹配或超过最强基线。据我们所知，这是首次将 LLM-as-judge 过程监督用于 FAS。

items.title_en: Redefining Synovial Pathotypes in Psoriatic Arthritis through Multi-Modal Histology and Machine Learning (The PSYNOVIUM Study)
items.title_zh: 通过多模态组织学与机器学习重新定义银屑病关节炎的滑膜病理类型（PSYNOVIUM 研究）
items.abstract_en: Background Synovial inflammation in psoriatic arthritis (PsA) lacks a validated histological classification framework. Current approaches apply rheumatoid arthritis (RA) synovial pathotypes to PsA, which overlooks immunobiological differences between the diseases and limits the predictive power of tissue stratification. We aimed to define data-driven, PsA-specific synovial pathotypes to facilitate tissue-driven precision medicine. Methods In this cross-sectional study, ultrasound-guided synovial biopsies were obtained from 61 patients with PsA (n=22), seropositive RA (n=23), seronegative RA (n=10), and other inflammatory arthritides (n=6). Sections underwent multi-modal staining, including H&E, picrosirius red, and immunohistochemistry for CD3, CD20, CD68, CD138, and CD31. Whole-slide digital image analysis and automated pixel classifiers quantified cellular and stromal metrics. Unsupervised hierarchical clustering identified intrinsic PsA pathotypes, which were correlated with clinical disease activity, radiographic osteoarthritis (OA), and longitudinal treatment responses. Findings While a subset of PsA patients shared an inflammatory signature with seropositive RA, unsupervised clustering of the PsA cohort revealed three distinct, novel pathotypes: Dense Myeloid (macrophage-driven), Fibro-Stromal (fibrosis and pauci-immune), and Angio-Lymphoid (hypervascular with significant CD138+ plasma cell infiltration). Pathotypes were independent of treatment and concurrent radiographic knee OA. The Fibro-Stromal pathotype correlated with significantly higher cutaneous psoriasis severity. Longitudinally, patients with the Fibro-Stromal pathotype exhibited a trend toward lower treatment response (44%) following standard interventions (methotrexate or TNF inhibitors) compared to the Dense Myeloid (50%) and Angio-Lymphoid (80%) pathotypes. Interpretation We present the first computationally derived synovial pathotypes specific to PsA, revealing distinct plasma cell and fibrotic architectures not captured by RA-centric models. To enable clinical translation, we distilled these findings into a pragmatic, four-marker diagnostic decision tree (CD31, CD68, CD138, and picrosirius red) designed for routine histopathology workflows, providing a staging ground for biomarker-stratified clinical trials in PsA. Funding Funding from the NIHR Biomedical Research Centre: Manchester, Arthritis UK, the Wellcome Trust, Brit-PACT, the National Psoriasis Foundation, and the Medical Research Council.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：银屑病关节炎（PsA）的滑膜炎症缺乏经过验证的组织学分类框架。当前方法将类风湿关节炎（RA）的滑膜病理类型套用于 PsA，忽视了疾病间的免疫生物学差异，并限制了组织分层的预测能力。我们旨在定义数据驱动的、PsA 特异的滑膜病理类型，以促进组织驱动的精准医学。方法：在这项横断面研究中，从 61 例患者获取超声引导下滑膜活检，包括 PsA（n=22）、血清阳性 RA（n=23）、血清阴性 RA（n=10）和其他炎性关节炎（n=6）。切片接受多模态染色，包括 H&E、天狼星红（picrosirius red），以及 CD3、CD20、CD68、CD138 和 CD31 的免疫组织化学。全切片数字图像分析和自动像素分类器量化细胞与基质指标。无监督层次聚类识别出内在 PsA 病理类型，并将其与临床疾病活动度、影像学骨关节炎（OA）和纵向治疗反应相关联。发现：虽然一部分 PsA 患者与血清阳性 RA 共享炎症特征，但对 PsA 队列的无监督聚类揭示了三种不同的新病理类型：致密髓系型（巨噬细胞驱动）、纤维基质型（纤维化和寡免疫）和血管淋巴样型（富血管并伴显著 CD138+ 浆细胞浸润）。病理类型独立于治疗和并发的影像学膝 OA。纤维基质型与显著更高的皮肤银屑病严重程度相关。纵向来看，纤维基质型患者在标准干预（甲氨蝶呤或 TNF 抑制剂）后表现出治疗反应较低的趋势（44%），而致密髓系型为 50%、血管淋巴样型为 80%。解释：我们提出了首个计算推导的 PsA 特异性滑膜病理类型，揭示了以 RA 为中心的模型未捕捉到的独特浆细胞和纤维化结构。为促进临床转化，我们将这些发现提炼为一个实用的四标志物诊断决策树（CD31、CD68、CD138 和天狼星红），设计用于常规组织病理学工作流程，为 PsA 中生物标志物分层的临床试验提供分期基础。资助：资助来自 NIHR 生物医学研究中心（曼彻斯特）、Arthritis UK、Wellcome Trust、Brit-PACT、National Psoriasis Foundation 和 Medical Research Council。

items.title_en: Stable, High-Charge, Laser-Driven VHEE Beams for Preclinical Applications
items.title_zh: 用于临床前应用的稳定高电荷激光驱动 VHEE 束
items.abstract_en: Laser-driven plasma accelerators (LPAs) are promising sources of very-high-energy-electron (VHEE) beams for medical applications, but increasing charge per pulse while maintaining pointing stability remains challenging. We demonstrate laser-accelerated beams with total charge per pulse reaching (559 $\pm$ 56) pC using an 80 TW laser system. The spectra have a dominant component at 40-60 MeV and a high-energy tail extending to approximately 200 MeV. Pointing jitter measured in air at the irradiation target plane reaches as low as 0.7 mrad. The beams were used for VHEE irradiation experiments involving a 10 mm region of interest through a 40 mm depth at 400 $\pm$ 20 mGy/pulse. Spectral reproducibility is quantified over fixed-setting shot sequences. Particle-in-cell simulations produce a peak-and-tail spectrum through acceleration in successive bubbles associated with a strongly modified plasma wake, providing a plausible mechanism for maintaining substantial accelerated charge despite strong beam loading. Dose-weighted time-of-flight calculations indicate an effective pulse dose rate of $10^{12}$ Gy/s and average dose rates of tens of Gy/min. These results establish an LPA operating regime relevant to preclinical VHEE irradiation.
items.abstract_zh: 激光驱动等离子体加速器（LPA）是医学应用中很有前景的极高能电子（VHEE）束来源，但在保持指向稳定性的同时提高每脉冲电荷仍具挑战性。我们使用 80 TW 激光系统展示了每脉冲总电荷达到（559 ± 56）pC 的激光加速束。光谱在 40–60 MeV 有主导成分，并有延伸至约 200 MeV 的高能尾部。在照射靶平面空气中测得的指向抖动低至 0.7 mrad。这些束用于 VHEE 照射实验，涉及通过 40 mm 深度的 10 mm 感兴趣区，剂量为 400 ± 20 mGy/脉冲。光谱可重复性在固定设置射击序列上量化。粒子网格（PIC）模拟通过与强烈修正的等离子体尾场相关的连续气泡中加速产生峰尾谱，为在强束流负载下仍保持可观加速电荷提供了合理解释机制。剂量加权飞行时间计算表明有效脉冲剂量率为 10^12 Gy/s，平均剂量率为数十 Gy/min。这些结果建立了一个与临床前 VHEE 照射相关的 LPA 运行区间。

items.title_en: Exploring Weight-Space Programming: Capabilities, Generalization, and Limitations
items.title_zh: 探索权重空间编程：能力、泛化与局限
items.abstract_en: Weight-Space Programming (WSP) enables reasoning agents to directly inspect and modify neural network parameters, offering an alternative to gradient-based model adaptation. However, its capabilities, cross-task generalization, and practical limitations remain insufficiently understood. We systematically investigate WSP through 16 editing trajectories across seven benchmarks and two model scales (Qwen3.5-0.8B and Qwen3.5-9B). Our findings reveal three key insights. First, WSP can achieve substantial performance gains through highly localized interventions. On full held-out evaluations, accuracy improves by up to 29.45, 4.42, 36.72, and 17.11 percentage points on MATH-500, GPQA Diamond, IFEval, and SciBench, respectively. Notably, modifying only 1,023 parameters yields a 29.45-point improvement. Second, WSP exhibits promising but uneven cross-task generalization. A Math-edited checkpoint improves GPQA Diamond, IFEval, and SciBench by 3.03, 12.18, and 20.10 points, respectively, without further editing, while leaving SciCode performance unchanged. Third, effective editing remains challenging and inconsistent. Outcomes vary substantially across trajectories, and six of the 16 trajectories retain the original weights when candidate improvements cannot be reliably validated. Together, these results highlight WSP's potential for highly localized model adaptation while revealing important challenges in intervention discovery, reliability, and cross-task transfer. Homepage: https://wsp-scope.github.io/ GitHub: https://github.com/WSP-Scope/WSP-Scope-Project
items.abstract_zh: 权重空间编程（WSP）使推理智能体能够直接检查和修改神经网络参数，为基于梯度的模型适配提供了替代方案。然而，其能力、跨任务泛化和实际局限仍未被充分理解。我们通过 16 条编辑轨迹，在七个基准和两个模型规模（Qwen3.5-0.8B 和 Qwen3.5-9B）上系统研究 WSP。我们的发现揭示三个关键见解。第一，WSP 可通过高度局部化的干预实现显著性能提升。在完整留出评估中，准确率在 MATH-500、GPQA Diamond、IFEval 和 SciBench 上分别最多提升 29.45、4.42、36.72 和 17.11 个百分点。值得注意的是，仅修改 1,023 个参数就带来 29.45 个百分点的提升。第二，WSP 展现出有前景但不均衡的跨任务泛化。一个经数学编辑的检查点在无需进一步编辑的情况下，将 GPQA Diamond、IFEval 和 SciBench 分别提升 3.03、12.18 和 20.10 个百分点，同时使 SciCode 性能保持不变。第三，有效编辑仍具挑战性且不一致。结果在不同轨迹间差异很大，16 条轨迹中有 6 条在候选改进无法可靠验证时保留原始权重。总之，这些结果突显了 WSP 在高度局部化模型适配方面的潜力，同时揭示了干预发现、可靠性和跨任务迁移方面的重要挑战。主页：https://wsp-scope.github.io/ GitHub：https://github.com/WSP-Scope/WSP-Scope-Project

items.title_en: Knowing When to Teach: Learning from Teachable Prefixes in Multilingual Reasoning Distillation
items.title_zh: 知道何时教学：在多语言推理蒸馏中从可教学前缀学习
items.abstract_en: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) improves reasoning by training a student on its own reasoning, using the same model conditioned on reference solutions as a teacher. Applying OPSD to multilingual reasoning requires the teacher to provide useful feedback across languages, even when the student makes mistakes in intermediate steps. We observe a phenomenon we call Teacher Drift: as these mistakes accumulate, the teacher may follow the student's incorrect steps instead of correcting them. Our analysis shows that this shift tends to occur earlier in lower-resource languages. To account for these differences across languages, we propose Teachable On-Policy Self-Distillation (TOPSD), which determines where and whether teacher supervision should be applied to each reasoning trajectory. TOPSD uses teacher-student likelihood to estimate where drift begins and select a prefix for supervision. It then verifies whether the teacher can recover the correct answer from that prefix, applying distillation only to prefixes that pass verification. Experiments on multilingual mathematical reasoning across ten languages and three model scales show that TOPSD consistently outperforms conventional OPSD, particularly in low- and medium-resource languages.
items.abstract_zh: 同策略自蒸馏（OPSD）通过让学生模型基于自身推理进行训练来提升推理能力，并使用同一模型以参考解为条件作为教师。将 OPSD 应用于多语言推理要求教师跨语言提供有用反馈，即使学生在中间步骤犯错。我们观察到一种称为教师漂移（Teacher Drift）的现象：随着这些错误累积，教师可能跟随学生的错误步骤而不是纠正它们。我们的分析表明，这种偏移在低资源语言中倾向于更早发生。为考虑跨语言差异，我们提出可教学同策略自蒸馏（TOPSD），它确定应对每条推理轨迹在何处以及是否应用教师监督。TOPSD 使用教师-学生似然估计漂移开始的位置，并选择用于监督的前缀。然后验证教师能否从该前缀恢复正确答案，仅对通过验证的前缀应用蒸馏。跨十种语言和三个模型规模的多语言数学推理实验表明，TOPSD 始终优于传统 OPSD，尤其是在低资源和中资源语言中。

items.title_en: SURE:Spatiotemporal Uncertainty Representation for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Learning
items.title_zh: SURE：面向高效视觉-语言-动作学习的时空不确定性表示
items.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies have become a promising paradigm for end-to-end robot control, but their effectiveness still depends heavily on large volumes of demonstration data. In manipulation tasks, this dependence is compounded by structured spatiotemporal uncertainty in the action space: multiple nearby actions or trajectories may successfully solve the same task, while semantically equivalent demonstrations often unfold at different speeds. Standard pointwise supervision treats each demonstrated action as an exact target, imposing an unnecessary learning burden under such uncertainty. We present SURE, a data-efficient VLA training framework that explicitly models both spatial and temporal uncertainty. SURE augments a VLA backbone with a lightweight transposed-convolutional probabilistic action decoder that captures spatial uncertainty through local correlations among neighboring action bins. It further introduces Soft-DTW alignment supervision to accommodate local timing variations between predicted and demonstrated action chunks. Together, these two components reduce sensitivity to demonstrator-specific poses and execution timing, enabling more data-efficient action learning. We evaluate SURE on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world manipulation tasks. Even with only 10% of the demonstration data or 20% of the training steps, SURE achieves manipulation success rates that match or surpass baseline VLAs.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略已成为端到端机器人控制的有前景范式，但其有效性仍严重依赖大量演示数据。在操作任务中，这种依赖因动作空间中结构化的时空不确定性而加剧：多个邻近动作或轨迹可能成功解决同一任务，而语义等价的演示常以不同速度展开。标准逐点监督将每个演示动作视为精确目标，在这种不确定性下造成不必要的学习负担。我们提出 SURE，一个数据高效的 VLA 训练框架，显式建模空间和时间不确定性。SURE 用轻量转置卷积概率动作解码器增强 VLA 主干，通过邻近动作分箱间的局部相关性捕捉空间不确定性。它进一步引入 Soft-DTW 对齐监督，以适应预测动作块与演示动作块之间的局部时序变化。这两个组件共同降低对演示者特定姿态和执行时序的敏感性，实现更数据高效的动作学习。我们在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0 和真实世界操作任务上评估 SURE。即使仅使用 10% 的演示数据或 20% 的训练步数，SURE 也达到与基线 VLA 匹配或超越的操作成功率。

items.title_en: Flex-RSI: Benchmarking Recursive Self-Improvement of Frontier Agents
items.title_zh: Flex-RSI：前沿智能体递归自我改进的基准测试
items.abstract_en: Frontier language models are increasingly deployed as agents, and how well an agent performs depends not only on its model but also on its harness: the prompts, tools, memory, and control loop through which the model acts. When an agent is applied to a new problem, a natural question is whether it can use the feedback of the task to improve the way it works, and not merely its answer. Most existing benchmarks keep the agent's harness fixed and score the solution it produces, or target large-scale model training. We introduce Flex-RSI, a benchmark for the recursive self-improvement of agents on vision and robotics tasks under a fixed budget. In each round, an executor improves the task solution, which is kept only if it scores higher on held-out validation data, and an improver then revises the harness, including the executor and itself. Every run starts from the same general-purpose harness, and the final solution is scored on hidden test data. Evaluating closed-source and open-weight models on tasks spanning perception, reasoning, robot action, 3D reconstruction, visual creation, and infrastructure, we find that self-improvement helps most when the agent builds its own solution, that feedback recording only success or failure holds back open-weight models, and that open-weight models fall furthest behind where outputs must pass strict checks of physical stability or exact correctness. Paired runs further show that editing the harness itself contributes to the gains.
items.abstract_zh: 前沿语言模型正越来越多地被部署为智能体，而智能体的表现不仅取决于其模型，也取决于其运行框架（harness）：模型借以行动的提示、工具、记忆和控制循环。当智能体被应用于新问题时，一个自然的问题是：它能否利用任务反馈来改进自己的工作方式，而不仅仅是改进其答案。现有大多数基准测试要么保持智能体框架固定并对其产生的解决方案评分，要么面向大规模模型训练。我们提出 Flex-RSI，这是一个用于在固定预算下评估智能体在视觉和机器人任务中递归自我改进的基准。在每一轮中，执行器改进任务解决方案，只有当该方案在留出验证数据上得分更高时才被保留；随后，改进器修订框架，包括执行器及其自身。每次运行都从相同的通用框架开始，最终解决方案在隐藏测试数据上评分。我们在涵盖感知、推理、机器人动作、3D 重建、视觉创作和基础设施的任务上评估闭源模型和开放权重模型，发现：当智能体构建自己的解决方案时，自我改进最有帮助；仅记录成功或失败的反馈会阻碍开放权重模型；开放权重模型在输出必须通过物理稳定性或精确正确性严格检查的任务上落后最多。配对运行进一步表明，编辑框架本身也有助于性能提升。

items.title_en: Stathmin-2 regulates microtubule dynamics and axonal resilience in human motor neurons
items.title_zh: Stathmin-2 调控人运动神经元中的微管动力学与轴突韧性
items.abstract_en: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is characterized by the selective degeneration of motor neurons, yet the mechanisms that either induce neurodegeneration or confer neuronal resilience remain poorly understood. Loss of the microtubule-associated protein Stathmin-2 (STMN2) is a downstream consequence of TDP-43 pathology present in nearly all cases of ALS and has emerged as a central feature of disease. However, the mechanisms by which STMN2 maintains homeostasis in motor neurons remain incompletely defined. Here, we investigated the role of STMN2 in regulating cytoskeletal organization and axonal function. Using TIRF microscopy, we quantified STMN2-dependent changes in microtubule growth and catastrophe at single-microtubule resolution. In human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived motor neurons, STMN2 depletion increased baseline rates of microtubule polymerization. However, STMN2 depletion impaired recovery of axonal microtubules following transient nocodazole-induced depolymerization, indicating that STMN2 is required for efficient cytoskeletal remodeling after stress. Consistent with these findings, STMN2-depleted neurons exhibited impaired microtubule recovery following acute depolymerization and reduced axonal recoil after optically induced local microtubule severing. Finally, STMN2 depletion disrupted the formation of neuromuscular junction-like contacts in human motor neuron-myocyte co-cultures, linking impaired cytoskeletal homeostasis to loss of distal neuronal connectivity. Together, these findings identify STMN2 as a key regulator of cytoskeletal resilience that coordinates microtubule remodeling, mitochondrial transport, and maintenance of neuromuscular junctions. We propose that impaired resilience of the axonal cytoskeleton represents a critical point of vulnerability in motor neurons in patients with ALS, establishing cytoskeletal resilience as a potential therapeutic target downstream of TDP-43 pathology.
items.abstract_zh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的特征是运动神经元的选择性变性，但诱导神经变性或赋予神经元韧性的机制仍知之甚少。微管相关蛋白 Stathmin-2（STMN2）的缺失是几乎所有 ALS 病例中都存在的 TDP-43 病理的下游后果，并已成为该疾病的核心特征。然而，STMN2 维持运动神经元稳态的机制仍未完全明确。在本研究中，我们探究了 STMN2 在调控细胞骨架组织和轴突功能中的作用。利用 TIRF 显微镜，我们在单微管分辨率下量化了 STMN2 依赖的微管生长和灾变变化。在人诱导多能干细胞来源的运动神经元中，STMN2 耗竭增加了微管聚合的基线速率。然而，STMN2 耗竭损害了短暂诺考达唑诱导的解聚后轴突微管的恢复，表明 STMN2 是应激后有效细胞骨架重塑所必需的。与这些发现一致，STMN2 耗竭的神经元在急性解聚后表现出微管恢复受损，并且在光学诱导的局部微管切断后轴突回缩减少。最后，STMN2 耗竭破坏了人运动神经元-肌细胞共培养中神经肌肉接头样接触的形成，将受损的细胞骨架稳态与远端神经连接丧失联系起来。总之，这些发现将 STMN2 确定为细胞骨架韧性的关键调控因子，协调微管重塑、线粒体运输和神经肌肉接头的维持。我们提出，轴突细胞骨架韧性受损代表了 ALS 患者运动神经元中的一个关键脆弱点，并将细胞骨架韧性确立为 TDP-43 病理下游的潜在治疗靶点。
