items.title_en: Analytical Modeling of the Admittance Tensor of Periodic Elliptical Meta-Atoms
items.title_zh: 周期椭圆超原子导纳张量的解析建模
items.abstract_en: A metasurface is an electrically thin interface that controls the phase, amplitude and polarization of a wave, upon reflection or transmission. Printed on a grounded dielectric substrate and spatially modulated across the aperture, it converts a guided surface wave into a radiated leaky wave, a mechanism used in holographic metasurface antennas. Controlling this conversion requires synthesizing a prescribed distribution of admittance tensors, each derived from the homogenization of a subwavelength unit cell. Many numerical and semi-analytical methods have been proposed to relate the geometry of a meta-atom to the tensor it produces. This paper presents, to the author's knowledge, the first analytical model, restricted to elliptical meta-atoms on a uniform lattice. The Galerkin method is applied directly to the geometry of the patches, without spatial meshing. An affine transformation maps any rotated ellipse onto the unit disk, so that a single formulation covers every configuration. A wideband response takes from minutes to tens of minutes with a periodic full-wave solver, while the proposed model evaluates it in a few tens of milliseconds on the same workstation, roughly three orders of magnitude faster. The predicted admittance agrees with a method-of-moments reference up to the fundamental resonance and captures the guided-mode anomaly of the substrate. Beyond the physical insight it brings, the model is a differentiable function of the geometry, which makes the quasi-real-time design of optimized metasurfaces possible.
items.abstract_zh: 超表面是一种电薄界面，在反射或透射时控制波的相位、幅度和极化。印刷在接地介质基板上并在孔径上进行空间调制时，它将导波表面波转换为辐射漏波，这是全息超表面天线中使用的一种机制。控制这种转换需要合成规定的导纳张量分布，每个导纳张量由亚波长晶胞的均匀化得到。已经提出了许多数值和半解析方法，将超原子的几何结构与其产生的张量联系起来。据作者所知，本文提出了首个解析模型，仅限于均匀晶格上的椭圆超原子。Galerkin方法直接应用于贴片的几何结构，无需空间网格划分。仿射变换将任何旋转椭圆映射到单位圆盘，因此单一公式覆盖每种配置。使用周期全波求解器计算宽带响应需要几分钟到几十分钟，而所提出的模型在同一工作站上可在几十毫秒内评估它，大约快三个数量级。预测的导纳在基频谐振之前与矩量法参考一致，并捕获了基板的导模异常。除了带来的物理洞察之外，该模型是几何结构的可微函数，这使得优化超表面的准实时设计成为可能。

items.title_en: Augmentron: Scalable Multi-View Visual Augmentation for Robot Learning
items.title_zh: Augmentron：面向机器人学习的可扩展多视图视觉增强
items.abstract_en: Robot policies trained on visually narrow demonstrations can become sensitive to environmental features that are unrelated to the task. Existing generative augmentation methods can introduce visual diversity, but processing every frame and camera view independently is computationally expensive and may produce inconsistent observations across cameras and timestamps. We introduce Augmentron, a geometry-aware pipeline that generates reusable scene representations and renders them through recorded camera poses. This produces temporally and multi-view consistent environ- ment and workspace variations while preserving the robot, task objects, actions, and annotations. Across three physical manipulation tasks, replacing half of the real world training dataset with Augmentron data improves model success across three tasks for both in out-of-distribution distractor objects, and out-of-distribution workspace variation evaluations. In a separate comparison against alternate augmentation techniques, Augmentron achieves the highest pooled success in all three conditions. The results show that introducing augmented data to a data training recipe can help policies generalize to dynamic real-world settings.
items.abstract_zh: 在视觉上狭窄的示范上训练的机器人策略可能会对与任务无关的环境特征变得敏感。现有的生成式增强方法可以引入视觉多样性，但独立处理每一帧和每个相机视图计算成本高昂，并且可能在不同相机和时间戳之间产生不一致的观察。我们引入Augmentron，一种几何感知流水线，生成可复用的场景表示并通过记录的相机位姿渲染它们。这会产生时间上和多视图一致的环境和工作空间变化，同时保留机器人、任务对象、动作和注释。在三个物理操作任务中，用Augmentron数据替换一半真实世界训练数据集，可在分布外干扰物体和分布外工作空间变化两类评估中提高三个任务的模型成功率。在与替代增强技术的单独比较中，Augmentron在所有三种条件下取得最高的汇总成功率。结果表明，将增强数据引入数据训练配方可以帮助策略泛化到动态真实世界环境。

items.title_en: Automatic keyphrase extraction and annotation: modern theoretical approaches and practical solutions for text and speech
items.title_zh: 自动关键短语抽取与标注：面向文本和语音的现代理论方法与实用解决方案
items.abstract_en: The exponential growth of textual and audiovisual information has made the task of automatic keyphrase extraction (KE) increasingly significant. This article provides a comprehensive analysis of contemporary theoretical approaches and practical solutions for KE across both text and speech modalities. The primary contribution of this work is its systematic synthesis of these often-disparate research strands into a unified analytical framework, highlighting the evolution of the field from statistical methods towards large language models (LLMs) and end-to-end speech processing. We examine the stages of KE, the characteristics of keyphrases in written and spoken language, and terminological nuances. Various methods for automatic KE are discussed and analyzed in detail: statistical, hybrid, machine learning-based, and structural. The review dedicates substantial attention to emerging paradigms, including keyphrase generation using LLMs, and provides a detailed overview of methodologies and challenges in automatic corpus annotation. Furthermore, we specifically analyze current directions and inherent difficulties in KE for spoken language, comparing transcript based and end-to-end acoustic approaches. This synthesis leads us to conclude that the field is moving towards a more integrated, context-aware paradigm. Future progress will depend on addressing key challenges such as data scarcity for low-resource languages, effective multimodal fusion, and the nuanced evaluation of generative KE systems.
items.abstract_zh: 文本和视听信息的指数级增长使自动关键短语抽取（KE）任务日益重要。本文全面分析了跨文本和语音模态的KE当代理论方法和实用解决方案。这项工作的主要贡献在于将这些通常分散的研究脉络系统地综合到一个统一的分析框架中，突出该领域从统计方法向大语言模型（LLMs）和端到端语音处理的演变。我们考察KE的各阶段、书面语和口语中关键短语的特征以及术语细微差别。详细讨论和分析了各种自动KE方法：统计、混合、基于机器学习和结构化方法。本综述重点关注新兴范式，包括使用LLMs进行关键短语生成，并详细概述自动语料库标注的方法和挑战。此外，我们专门分析口语KE的当前方向和固有困难，比较基于转录文本和端到端声学的方法。这一综合使我们得出结论：该领域正朝着更集成、上下文感知的范式发展。未来的进展将取决于解决关键挑战，例如低资源语言的数据稀缺、有效的多模态融合以及对生成式KE系统的细致评估。

items.title_en: Radio-to-Pose Information for Gauge-Drift Correction in Cooperative Localization
items.title_zh: 用于协同定位中规范漂移校正的Radio-to-Pose Information
items.abstract_en: Cooperative localization uses odometry and inter-robot measurements to estimate the motion of a robot team. These measurements describe only relative geometry, but the team's estimated position and orientation can drift together over time, i.e., gauge drift. In this work, we study correction of this gauge drift using a radio attenuation map registered in the same world coordinate frame used for robot poses. Specifically, we propose Radio-to-Pose Information (RPI), an interface that converts power residuals and their pose derivatives into a Gaussian information matrix and vector pair. RPI builds on the insight that received power is sensitive to shared displacement in the world map. The pose estimator uses the interface together with odometry and inter-robot measurements to update poses and minimize uncertainty. We characterize the shared motions detectable from the map and observed links. For an uncertain shared map, RPI keeps correlations across robots and time and reproduces joint Gaussian pose estimates and covariances. Across $1000$ simulated Gaussian trials, RPI matches the results of joint estimation. Across 32 paired trials with a registered map, RPI reduces common-position RMSE from $0.542$m to $0.140$m in a $50\times50$m arena compared with a baseline that uses radio only to weight relative measurements.
items.abstract_zh: 协同定位使用里程计和机器人间测量来估计机器人团队的运动。这些测量仅描述相对几何关系，但团队估计的位置和方向可能随时间一起漂移，即规范漂移。在这项工作中，我们研究使用配准到与机器人位姿相同世界坐标系中的无线电衰减图来校正这种规范漂移。具体而言，我们提出Radio-to-Pose Information（RPI），一种将功率残差及其位姿导数转换为高斯信息矩阵和向量对的接口。RPI基于以下见解：接收功率对世界地图中的共享位移敏感。位姿估计器将该接口与里程计和机器人间测量一起使用，以更新位姿并最小化不确定性。我们表征了可从地图和观测链路中检测到的共享运动。对于不确定的共享地图，RPI保持跨机器人和时间的相关性，并重现联合高斯位姿估计和协方差。在1000次模拟高斯试验中，RPI与联合估计的结果相匹配。在32次带有配准地图的配对试验中，与仅使用无线电对相对测量进行加权的基线相比，RPI在50×50 m场地中将共同位置RMSE从0.542 m降低到0.140 m。

items.title_en: PoseRieFlow: Riemannian Flow Matching for Whole-Body Text-to-Pose Generation
items.title_zh: PoseRieFlow：面向全身文本到姿态生成的黎曼流匹配
items.abstract_en: We present PoseRieFlow, a compact flow-matching framework for text-conditioned generation of whole-body 3D human poses. Prior text-to-pose methods either neglect articulated hands or model rotations in Euclidean space despite their non-Euclidean geometry. PoseRieFlow instead formulates generation directly on the product manifold of SMPL-H joint rotations, learning a text-conditioned vector field that transports samples from an isotropic $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ Gaussian prior to the data distribution along Riemannian geodesics. A part-tokenized Diffusion Transformer aggregates the 52 joints into eight body-part tokens, allocating a dedicated token and nonlinear projector to each hand, and restores per-joint resolution through part-specific decoders, shortening the sequence while improving kinematic fidelity over per-joint tokenization. With only 21.6M trainable parameters, PoseRieFlow supports expressive SMPL-H generation with detailed hand articulation at a fraction of the scale of recent LLM-based generators. On PoseScript, it attains the lowest whole-body kinematic error among all hand-producing methods, with consistent kinematic gains from the Riemannian formulation over its Euclidean counterpart at every practical inference budget, while distributional and retrieval metrics remain comparable between them.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 PoseRieFlow，一个紧凑的流匹配框架，用于文本条件下全身 3D 人体姿态的生成。此前的文本到姿态方法要么忽略关节手部，要么尽管旋转具有非欧几里得几何性质仍在欧几里得空间中建模旋转。PoseRieFlow 则直接在 SMPL-H 关节旋转的乘积流形上构建生成，学习一个文本条件向量场，沿黎曼测地线将样本从各向同性 SO(3) 高斯先验输运到数据分布。部分标记化的 Diffusion Transformer 将 52 个关节聚合为八个身体部位 token，为每只手分配专用 token 和非线性投影器，并通过部位特定解码器恢复逐关节分辨率，从而在缩短序列的同时相较逐关节标记化提升运动学保真度。PoseRieFlow 仅有 21.6M 可训练参数，却能在远小于近期基于 LLM 的生成器的规模下支持具有详细手部关节运动的富有表现力的 SMPL-H 生成。在 PoseScript 上，它在所有生成手部的方法中取得最低的全身运动学误差，并且在每个实际推理预算下，黎曼形式相较其欧几里得对应形式均带来一致的运动学增益，而二者的分布指标和检索指标仍相当。

items.title_en: Integrated genotyping, annotation and epigenetic characterization of transposable elements with GraffiTE
items.title_zh: 使用 GraffiTE 对转座元件进行整合的基因分型、注释与表观遗传表征
items.abstract_en: Genotyping, annotating and characterizing TE variation leaped forward with long-read sequencing (LRS) and de novo assembly. LRS techniques also reveal CpG methylation, which enables measuring the impact of TEs on epigenomes and sheds light on the role of TEs as regulatory sequences. Yet, TE genotyping tools discard the valuable allele-specific epigenetic information. We introduce GraffiTE v1.1, the first Nextflow pipeline that genotypes SVs, annotates polymorphic mobile elements (MEI), and maps epigenetic data to TEs using pangenome graphs in one command. GraffiTE v1.1 is designed to map any epigenetic information that is based on LRS stencils, including Fiber-seq. We demonstrate the capabilities of GraffiTE v1.1 by analyzing genomes and methylomes obtained from 20 Quebec residents of French-Canadian descent. In these genomes, TE annotation yields 4,908 Alu, 704 LINE1, 112 SVA and 21 HERVK (HML-2) distinct polymorphic mobile elements (MEIs). We also identify 10 fixed HERVK insertions that vary between solo LTR and provirus, or in proviral copy number. We determine that these MEIs contribute 144,748 additional CpGs not present in the reference. From this, we identify 480 Alus, 67 LINE1s, 12 SVAs and 2 HERVKs in hypomethylated states. We note that Alus and SVAs are more methylated than other LINE1 and HERVK. Lastly, MEIs dating reported a mean of age 1.08 Mya (median: 640 kya) and beta regression identified a moderate demethylating effect of age on MEIs (effect: -0.069 log-odds per log10 years, P < 6.08 x 10-19). Our results show that the methylation level of a LINE1 MEI is expected to decrease from 86.4% to 80.8% in the first Mya. In conclusion, GraffiTE v1.1 genotypes SVs, annotates MEI, and characterizes their epigenetic state at the scale of populations by leveraging the full potential of LRS. While we showcase its application in human data, the pipeline can be deployed in any model for which a TE library is available.
items.abstract_zh: 长读长测序（LRS）和从头组装推动了转座元件（TE）变异的基因分型、注释与表征的飞跃。LRS 技术还揭示 CpG 甲基化，从而能够测量 TE 对表观基因组的影响，并阐明 TE 作为调控序列的作用。然而，TE 基因分型工具丢弃了有价值的等位基因特异性表观遗传信息。我们推出 GraffiTE v1.1，这是首个可通过一条命令完成 SV 基因分型、多态移动元件（MEI）注释以及利用泛基因组图将表观遗传数据映射到 TE 的 Nextflow 流水线。GraffiTE v1.1 旨在映射任何基于 LRS stencil 的表观遗传信息，包括 Fiber-seq。我们通过分析来自 20 名法裔加拿大血统魁北克居民的基因组和甲基化组，展示了 GraffiTE v1.1 的能力。在这些基因组中，TE 注释得到 4,908 个 Alu、704 个 LINE1、112 个 SVA 和 21 个 HERVK（HML-2）不同的多态移动元件（MEI）。我们还鉴定出 10 个固定的 HERVK 插入，它们在单独 LTR 与原病毒之间、或在前病毒拷贝数上存在差异。我们确定这些 MEI 贡献了参考序列中不存在的 144,748 个额外 CpG。由此，我们鉴定出 480 个 Alu、67 个 LINE1、12 个 SVA 和 2 个 HERVK 处于低甲基化状态。我们注意到 Alu 和 SVA 的甲基化程度高于其他 LINE1 和 HERVK。最后，MEI 定年报告平均年龄为 1.08 Mya（中位数：640 kya），beta 回归发现年龄对 MEI 具有中等程度的去甲基化效应（效应：每 log10 年 -0.069 log-odds，P < 6.08 x 10-19）。我们的结果表明，一个 LINE1 MEI 的甲基化水平预计在第一个 Mya 内从 86.4% 降至 80.8%。总之，GraffiTE v1.1 通过充分利用 LRS 的潜力，在群体尺度上对 SV 进行基因分型、注释 MEI 并表征其表观遗传状态。虽然我们展示了其在人类数据中的应用，但该流水线可部署于任何有可用 TE 库的模型。

items.title_en: An Agent-Driven, Cross-Validated Inverse-Design Pipeline for Dielectric Metasurfaces
items.title_zh: 用于介质超表面的智能体驱动、交叉验证逆向设计流水线
items.abstract_en: Inverse design of dielectric metasurfaces is powerful but labour-intensive: each new target requires choosing a parameterization and a figure of merit, managing compute resources, and critically assessing results that may be numerically unconverged, sensitive to fabrication errors or trapped in local optima. Here we present an open-source pipeline in which an artificial intelligence (AI) coding agent turns a plain-language specification into metasurface optimization runs, executes them, analyses every run with a fixed checklist and proposes the next iteration. Designs are optimized with differentiable three-dimensional rigorous coupled-wave analysis (RCWA), including robustness to fabrication tolerances, and every reported design is independently verified with finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) simulations. We demonstrate the workflow at 1550 nm on a freeform silicon metagrating, on a polarization-independent meta-atom library assembled into beam-deflecting supercells, and on metalenses built from the same library. In the metagrating case, the independent FDTD verification revealed a 5\% overestimate of the efficiency by the optimization model that a conventional convergence test had not detected, and the robust design retained most of its efficiency under $\pm$10~nm fabrication errors. In the other cases, instead, the obtained RCWA results are confirmed by full-wave simulations.
items.abstract_zh: 介质超表面的逆向设计功能强大但劳动密集：每个新目标都需要选择参数化和品质因数、管理计算资源，并批判性地评估可能数值未收敛、对制造误差敏感或陷入局部最优的结果。在此，我们提出一个开源流水线，其中人工智能（AI）编码智能体将自然语言规范转化为超表面优化运行，执行这些运行，用固定检查清单分析每次运行，并提出下一次迭代。设计通过可微的三维严格耦合波分析（RCWA）进行优化，包括对制造公差的鲁棒性，并且每个报告的设计都用有限差分时域（FDTD）仿真独立验证。我们在 1550 nm 下，在自由形状硅超光栅、组装成光束偏转超胞的偏振无关超原子库以及由同一库构建的超透镜上展示了该工作流。在超光栅案例中，独立的 FDTD 验证揭示了优化模型对效率高估 5%，而传统收敛测试未检测到这一点；鲁棒设计在 ±10 nm 制造误差下保留了大部分效率。在其他案例中，所获得的 RCWA 结果则由全波仿真确认。

items.title_en: KnowEvo: Knowledge Evolution for Protein Optimization
items.title_zh: KnowEvo：面向蛋白质优化的知识演化
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in scientific discovery, yet systematically accumulating and refining reusable scientific knowledge remains challenging. Existing approaches primarily improve LLM-based problem solving through parameter optimization or feedback-driven refinement of prompts, programs, and solution trajectories, leaving acquired expertise either embedded in model weights or scattered across iterative problem-solving processes. As a result,knowledge is difficult to systematically inspect, evaluate, and refine. We propose KnowEvo, a framework that treats externalized knowledge itself as the optimization target. Our key insight is that scientific knowledge is inherently modular: multiple interacting mechanisms jointly determine the design outcomes. This makes knowledge evolution fundamentally challenging, as improvements cannot be attributed to individual components in isolation. To address this, KnowEvo represents knowledge as executable expertise blocks and organizes their refinements into strategy mutation trees, enabling structured exploration over a combinatorial knowledge space. The framework combines a Thompson-style forward allocation strategy that adaptively distributes evaluation budgets across strategy variants with a backward revision process, in which a code agent operates in an isolated sandbox to translate rollout evidence into localized program updates. This design enables persistent accumulation, evaluation, and refinement of mechanistic expertise across iterative experimentation. We evaluate KnowEvo on protein optimization tasks including stability and solubility. Results show that knowledge evolution consistently improves over initial strategy blocks and outperforms monolithic program evolution and prior LLM-guided evolution baselines across metrics such as pass@k, MRR, MAP,and NDCG@5. Code is available at https://github.com/recynie/KnowEvo.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在科学发现中展现出前景，但系统性地积累和提炼可复用的科学知识仍然具有挑战性。现有方法主要通过参数优化或反馈驱动的提示、程序和求解轨迹改进来提升基于 LLM 的问题求解，使获得的知识要么嵌入模型权重，要么分散在迭代式问题求解过程中。因此，知识难以被系统地检查、评估和提炼。我们提出 KnowEvo，一个将外化知识本身作为优化目标的框架。我们的关键洞见是科学知识本质上是模块化的：多个相互作用的机制共同决定设计结果。这使得知识演化从根本上具有挑战性，因为改进无法孤立地归因于单个组件。为解决此问题，KnowEvo 将知识表示为可执行的专长模块，并将其改进组织为策略变异树，从而能够在组合知识空间上进行结构化探索。该框架结合了 Thompson 式前向分配策略，自适应地在策略变体之间分配评估预算，以及后向修订过程，其中代码智能体在隔离沙箱中运行，将 rollout 证据转化为局部程序更新。该设计能够在迭代实验中持续积累、评估和提炼机制性专长。我们在包括稳定性和溶解性的蛋白质优化任务上评估 KnowEvo。结果表明，知识演化相较于初始策略模块持续改进，并在 pass@k、MRR、MAP 和 NDCG@5 等指标上优于单体程序演化和先前的 LLM 引导演化基线。代码见 https://github.com/recynie/KnowEvo。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: The Last Mile to the Real World: Agent-Native Primitives as Reusable Building Blocks for Solving Real-World Tasks
items.title_zh: 通往现实世界的最后一英里：将智能体原生原语作为解决现实世界任务的可复用构建块
items.abstract_en: How can an agent handle a real-world task end to end? Frontier models with their own harnesses still fall short on real-world benchmarks: on Terminal-Bench 4.0, GPT-5.6 Sol with Codex resolves 37.3% of the tasks and Claude Opus 5 with Claude Code 51.8%. These tasks fail at the step from reaching a resource to applying it, which we call the last mile to the real world. Existing approaches put the resource within reach but leave the competence to apply it with the caller, so each harness rebuilds that competence. We introduce agent-native primitives, reusable units that equip a resource with a resident LLM that applies it in context and communicates with other primitives, and HEELO (Harness Engineering around Evolving Agent-Native Primitives for the Last Mile to Real-WOrld Tasks), a harness engineering framework that builds each task's harness from a library of such primitives. HEELO composes the primitives a task needs into a task-specific graph, verifies the result against evidence from the environment, revises the primitives a failure implicates, and admits new or improved primitives after validation. We instantiate HEELO with eight primitive families, each built for one kind of task, and evaluate them on more than twenty benchmarks. Dev-Primitives raise Terminal-Bench 4.0 resolution from 37.3% under Codex to 55.5% on the same backbone, Harness Primitives composed per task raise Terminal-Bench 2.0 Pass@1 from 60.0% for the seed harness to 72.2%, Tool Primitives raise ToolBench pass rate from 55.8% to 75.1%, and Navigation Primitives raise GAIA-Text-103 accuracy from 45.6% to 58.3%. On the 46 real-world tasks of our heelo.dev platform, Claude Opus 5.5 with Claude Code and GPT-6.1 Sol with Codex complete 9 each on their own and 39 and 35 when connected to HEELO through our MCP server, with 1.9$\times$ and 2.3$\times$ less time and 1.55$\times$ lower cost per completed task.
items.abstract_zh: 智能体如何端到端地处理现实世界任务？前沿模型及其自有 harness 在现实世界基准上仍表现不足：在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 上，GPT-5.6 Sol 配合 Codex 解决了 37.3% 的任务，Claude Opus 5 配合 Claude Code 解决了 51.8%。这些任务在从触达资源到应用资源的步骤上失败，我们称之为通往现实世界的最后一英里。现有方法使资源触手可及，但将应用资源的能力留给调用者，因此每个 harness 都要重新构建这种能力。我们提出智能体原生原语（agent-native primitives），即可复用单元，为资源配备一个常驻 LLM，使其在上下文中应用该资源并与其他原语通信；以及 HEELO（Harness Engineering around Evolving Agent-Native Primitives for the Last Mile to Real-WOrld Tasks），一个 harness 工程框架，从此类原语库中为每个任务构建 harness。HEELO 将任务所需原语组合成任务特定图，依据环境证据验证结果，修订失败所涉及的原语，并在验证后接纳新的或改进的原语。我们用八个原语族实例化 HEELO，每个族针对一类任务构建，并在二十多个基准上评估它们。Dev-Primitives 将 Terminal-Bench 4.0 的解决率从 Codex 下的 37.3% 提升到同一骨干上的 55.5%；按任务组合的 Harness Primitives 将 Terminal-Bench 2.0 Pass@1 从种子 harness 的 60.0% 提升到 72.2%；Tool Primitives 将 ToolBench 通过率从 55.8% 提升到 75.1%；Navigation Primitives 将 GAIA-Text-103 准确率从 45.6% 提升到 58.3%。在我们 heelo.dev 平台的 46 个现实世界任务上，Claude Opus 5.5 配合 Claude Code 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 配合 Codex 各自独立完成 9 个，而在通过我们的 MCP 服务器连接到 HEELO 时分别完成 39 和 35 个，每个完成任务的时间分别减少 1.9× 和 2.3×，成本降低 1.55×。

items.title_en: An Integrated Open-Source Stack for Vision-Based Autonomous Navigation of Wheeled Rovers
items.title_zh: 用于轮式漫游车视觉自主导航的集成开源栈
items.abstract_en: Vision-based rover autonomy requires integrating perception, localization, planning and platform-specific control under limited sensing and computing resources. We present an open-source ROS 2 stack for following directional arrows, reaching a terminal cone and returning autonomously to the start. It connects YOLOv8n detection and geometric direction, range and bearing estimation with RGB-D SLAM, wheel-inertial state estimation, kinematics-aware planning, behavior-tree mission management and STM32 actuation. Standard interfaces separate reusable autonomy from the hardware layer; a proportional path-following plugin supports low-speed rover motion. Public resources include software, configuration, a labeled dataset, trained weights and evaluation logs. On 478 held-out images, the detector achieves mAP@0.5 of 0.720 under the Ultralytics evaluator and outperforms a classical OpenCV baseline under a shared evaluation protocol. The reported perception latency is 25 ms on a Jetson Orin NX. Three missions, one indoor and two outdoor, demonstrate marker-guided navigation and autonomous return without operator motion commands or reported collisions. Field results document integration failures and corrective choices; repeated instrumented trials remain necessary to quantify physical navigation errors and reliability.
items.abstract_zh: 基于视觉的漫游车自主性需要在有限的感知和计算资源下集成感知、定位、规划和平台特定控制。我们提出一个开源 ROS 2 栈，用于沿方向箭头行进、到达终点锥桶并自主返回起点。它将 YOLOv8n 检测以及几何方向、距离和方位估计与 RGB-D SLAM、轮式-惯性状态估计、运动学感知规划、行为树任务管理和 STM32 执行连接起来。标准接口将可复用自主性与硬件层分离；一个比例路径跟踪插件支持低速漫游车运动。公开资源包括软件、配置、标注数据集、训练权重和评估日志。在 478 张留出图像上，检测器在 Ultralytics 评估器下达到 mAP@0.5 为 0.720，并在共享评估协议下优于经典 OpenCV 基线。报告的感知延迟在 Jetson Orin NX 上为 25 ms。三次任务（一次室内、两次室外）展示了标记引导导航和自主返回，无需操作员运动指令且未报告碰撞。现场结果记录了集成失败和纠正选择；仍需要重复的仪器化试验来量化物理导航误差和可靠性。

items.title_en: Video Stitching from Multiple Moving Cameras
items.title_zh: 多台移动相机拍摄的视频拼接
items.abstract_en: We address geometric video alignment for the same scene captured by multiple freely moving cameras. Existing methods, which are based on image stitching or video stabilization, are typically limited to two cameras or must assume the restrictive setting of a fixed linear ordering of the cameras. We propose MViS, a lightweight test-time optimization framework for joint multi-view alignment with temporal consistency. MViS uses a spatial-transformer-inspired net to jointly process frames from all views within a short temporal window and predict per-view, per-time homographies. Optimization proceeds in two stages: geometry-guided alignment followed by appearance-based refinement, with both stages enforcing multi-view and temporal consistency across the sequence. The method requires no scene-specific hyperparameter tuning, handles arbitrary and time-varying view-intersection graphs, and remains robust under rapid camera motion. On a standard two-view video benchmark, MViS matches or surpasses the state of the art. To facilitate evaluation in more complex scenarios, we introduce an annotated dataset with more than two freely moving cameras and establish the first benchmark for this setting. Project page: https://bgu-cs-vil.github.io/MViS-project/ .
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究由多台自由移动相机拍摄的同一场景的几何视频对齐问题。现有基于图像拼接或视频稳像的方法通常局限于两台相机，或必须假设相机具有固定线性排序这一限制性设置。我们提出 MViS，一个轻量级的测试时优化框架，用于具有时间一致性的联合多视角对齐。MViS 使用受空间变换器启发的网络，在短时间窗口内联合处理来自所有视角的帧，并预测每视角、每时刻的单应性矩阵。优化分两个阶段进行：几何引导的对齐，随后是基于外观的细化；两个阶段都在整个序列上强制多视角一致性和时间一致性。该方法无需针对场景调整超参数，可处理任意且随时间变化的视角交集图，并在相机快速运动下保持稳健。在标准双视角视频基准上，MViS 达到或超过当前最先进水平。为便于在更复杂场景中进行评估，我们引入一个包含两台以上自由移动相机的标注数据集，并为该设置建立首个基准。项目页面：https://bgu-cs-vil.github.io/MViS-project/ 。

items.title_en: Core MCC of Arabidopsis thaliana: structural dissection provides new insights into Mad2, BubR1 and CDC20
items.title_zh: 拟南芥核心 MCC：结构解析为 Mad2、BubR1 和 CDC20 提供新见解
items.abstract_en: The spindle assembly checkpoint (SAC) is a mechanism executed mainly by the mitotic checkpoint complex (MCC) to monitor the anchoring of mitotic spindle microtubules to ensure correct chromosome segregation. Although knowledge of protein-protein interactions in the plant cell cycle has progressed in recent years, information on the SAC mechanism in this context remains scarce. Here, we used bigBac, chemical crosslinking, mass spectrometry and structural analysis to identify protein-protein interactions (PPIs) among AtCDC20, AtBubR1 (BMF2) and AtMad2, which are components of the core MCC26 in A. thaliana. Fifty-three nonredundant crosslinks were identified, with multiple binding sites in different domains and subdomains of these proteins, such as the {beta}-propeller (AtCDC20), tetratricopeptide domain, and KEN boxes, including a new KET box (AtBubR1) and Horma domain (AtMad2). We also identified a hierarchy of interactions between these three proteins, with the potential to regulate signalling through the SAC molecular mechanism. Interactions that characterize the Mad2 tetramer, with the coupling of two dimers, were also identified. No PPIs were identified for AtBub1 (BMF1) or AtBub3:1, revealing a significant difference in MCC formation compared with that in other eukaryotes. Our findings provide a structural basis for core MCC formation in A. thaliana and offer new insights into the proteins CDC20, BubR1 and Mad2 in the context of the SAC.
items.abstract_zh: 纺锤体组装检查点（SAC）是一种主要由有丝分裂检查点复合体（MCC）执行的机制，用于监测有丝分裂纺锤体微管的锚定，以确保染色体正确分离。尽管近年来植物细胞周期中蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用的知识有所进展，但该背景下关于 SAC 机制的信息仍然稀少。在这里，我们使用 bigBac、化学交联、质谱和结构分析来鉴定拟南芥核心 MCC26 组分 AtCDC20、AtBubR1（BMF2）和 AtMad2 之间的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）。共鉴定出 53 个非冗余交联，在这些蛋白质的不同结构域和亚结构域中存在多个结合位点，例如 β-螺旋桨（AtCDC20）、四三肽重复结构域和 KEN 框，包括一个新的 KET 框（AtBubR1）和 Horma 结构域（AtMad2）。我们还鉴定了这三种蛋白质之间的相互作用层级，其具有通过 SAC 分子机制调节信号传导的潜力。还鉴定了表征 Mad2 四聚体（由两个二聚体偶联）的相互作用。未鉴定到 AtBub1（BMF1）或 AtBub3:1 的 PPI，揭示了与其他真核生物相比 MCC 形成的显著差异。我们的发现为拟南芥核心 MCC 的形成提供了结构基础，并为 SAC 背景下的 CDC20、BubR1 和 Mad2 蛋白提供了新见解。

items.title_en: Approaching quantum limits in sub-Rayleigh resolution using phase modulation optimization
items.title_zh: 利用相位调制优化逼近亚瑞利分辨率中的量子极限
items.abstract_en: Spatial-mode demultiplexing (SPADE) has made significant progress in incoherent optical imaging and has been implemented through various experimental approaches. Holography-based SPADE is widely used in proof-of-principle experiments because of its low cost, stable optical arrangement, and ease of implementation. However, its low photon utilization severely limits its practical applications. Alternating Fourier transforms and phase modulations can implement unitary optical transformations. Building on this idea, we use backpropagation to optimize the phase profiles of spatial light modulators (SLMs) and thereby design quantum measurements that are efficient in both information and energy. We study centroid--separation estimation for two incoherent point sources, using Fisher information or the estimation errors of an auxiliary neural network estimator as optimization objectives. As the number of SLMs increases, the optimized measurements approach the quantum limits characterized by the quantum Cramér-Rao bound and the information-regret tradeoff relation. With a few SLMs, our method can outperform direct imaging, showing its potential for superresolution imaging.
items.abstract_zh: 空间模式解复用（SPADE）在非相干光学成像中已取得显著进展，并已通过多种实验方法实现。基于全息术的 SPADE 因成本低、光学布置稳定且易于实现，被广泛用于原理验证实验。然而，其低光子利用率严重限制了实际应用。交替的傅里叶变换和相位调制可以实现酉光学变换。基于这一思想，我们使用反向传播优化空间光调制器（SLM）的相位分布，从而设计在信息和能量两方面都高效的量子测量。我们研究两个非相干点源的质心—间距估计，使用 Fisher 信息或辅助神经网络估计器的估计误差作为优化目标。随着 SLM 数量的增加，优化后的测量逼近由量子 Cramér-Rao 界和信息-遗憾权衡关系所表征的量子极限。在少量 SLM 的情况下，我们的方法可以优于直接成像，显示其在超分辨成像中的潜力。

items.title_en: Energy-Aware Vertically Layered Pinching-Antenna System Design with Probabilistic LoS Availability
items.title_zh: 能量感知的垂直分层捏合天线系统设计：考虑概率性 LoS 可用性
items.abstract_en: This paper investigates a vertically layered pinching antenna (PA) system, in which dielectric waveguides deployed at different heights provide additional vertical spatial degrees of freedom for line-of-sight (LoS)-favorable PA placement. We consider a practical energy model that captures in-waveguide attenuation, base station-to-feed-point optical-fiber loss, and PA repositioning energy, along with a statistical LoS-availability model that depends on elevation and distance. We then jointly optimize the transmit beamforming, PA positions, time allocation, and transmission rates to maximize the expected successfully delivered frame-effective sum rate under per-user outage and quality-of-service constraints. To avoid enumerating the exponentially many LoS states, we derive a certified conditional-moment outage envelope for outage-guaranteed rate selection and a differentiable safe approximation of the chance constraints to facilitate tractable optimization. Building on these results, a block coordinate descent algorithm with a penalty-aided majorization-minimization procedure attains a high-quality suboptimal solution. Simulation results confirm the gains of vertical layering and reveal a fundamental energy-LoS tradeoff: LoS-favorable PA placement generally enhances both performance and reliability, although it incurs higher attenuation, path loss, and energy costs.
items.abstract_zh: 本文研究一种垂直分层捏合天线（PA）系统，其中部署在不同高度的介质波导为有利于视距（LoS）的 PA 放置提供额外的垂直空间自由度。我们考虑一个实际能量模型，该模型涵盖波导内衰减、基站到馈电点光纤损耗以及 PA 重新定位能量，并考虑依赖仰角和距离的统计 LoS 可用性模型。然后，我们联合优化发射波束成形、PA 位置、时间分配和传输速率，以在每用户中断和服务质量约束下最大化成功交付的帧有效和速率的期望。为避免枚举指数级数量的 LoS 状态，我们推导了一个经认证的条件矩中断包络，用于具有中断保证的速率选择，并推导了机会约束的可微安全近似，以促进可处理的优化。基于这些结果，采用惩罚辅助的主化-最小化过程的块坐标下降算法获得高质量次优解。仿真结果证实了垂直分层的增益，并揭示了一个基本的能量-LoS 权衡：有利于 LoS 的 PA 放置通常能提升性能和可靠性，尽管会带来更高的衰减、路径损耗和能量成本。

items.title_en: ROSE: Risk-Aware Orthogonal Subspace Navigation for Lifelong Knowledge Editing in Multimodal Large Language Models
items.title_zh: ROSE：面向多模态大语言模型终身知识编辑的风险感知正交子空间导航
items.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) require continuous factual updates to stay current, yet lifelong knowledge editing remains a daunting challenge. The primary obstacle is the severe Locality Erosion and Catastrophic Forgetting, where sequential edits inevitably interfere with pre-trained capabilities and prior updates. In this paper, we propose \textbf{ROSE}, a \textbf{R}isk-aware \textbf{O}rthogonal \textbf{S}ubspace navigation framework for lifelong knowledge \textbf{E}diting. ROSE addresses forgetting by aiming to restrict parameter updates to the orthogonal complement of previously edited subspaces. Crucially, it introduces a risk-guided mechanism that utilizes a dynamically computed risk mask to safeguard specific factual parameter subspaces essential for model stability. During inference, ROSE employs a multi-granularity knowledge integration strategy, featuring prototype-anchored semantic gating and perturbation-driven subspace fusion to precisely activate edited knowledge for relevant queries while limiting interference on unrelated inputs. Comprehensive experiments on two prominent multimodal benchmarks show that ROSE is competitive with state-of-the-art approaches across five key metrics, while maintaining outstanding stability over $1,000$ sequential updates. Our code is available at https://github.com/sunlitsong/ROSE.
items.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）需要持续进行事实更新以保持时效性，但终身知识编辑仍然是一项艰巨挑战。主要障碍是严重的局部性侵蚀和灾难性遗忘，即顺序编辑不可避免地干扰预训练能力和先前的更新。本文提出 ROSE，一个用于终身知识编辑的风险感知正交子空间导航框架。ROSE 通过将参数更新限制在先前编辑子空间的正交补中来解决遗忘问题。关键的是，它引入一种风险引导机制，利用动态计算的风险掩码来保护对模型稳定性至关重要的特定事实参数子空间。在推理时，ROSE 采用多粒度知识集成策略，具有原型锚定的语义门控和扰动驱动的子空间融合，以针对相关查询精确激活已编辑知识，同时限制对无关输入的干扰。在两个著名多模态基准上的综合实验表明，ROSE 在五项关键指标上与最先进方法具有竞争力，同时在超过 1,000 次顺序更新中保持出色的稳定性。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/sunlitsong/ROSE 获取。

items.title_en: Unified Overview of Safety Certificate Functions: Techniques from Hamilton--Jacobi Reachability and Control Barrier Functions
items.title_zh: 安全证书函数的统一概述：Hamilton–Jacobi 可达性分析与控制屏障函数技术
items.abstract_en: Safety is a central concern in modern autonomous systems. Safety certificates---functions whose existence guarantees that a system meets its safety specification---have long been used as a principled tool for rigorously reasoning about safety. Methods for synthesizing such certificates are scattered across research areas, with little guidance on when to use a particular approach. This tutorial provides a holistic treatment of safety certificate synthesis centered on two widely used families: Hamilton--Jacobi (HJ) reachability analysis and control barrier functions (CBFs). For each family of methods, we first introduce its general formulation, along with classical and learning-based tools for certificate synthesis. Next, we introduce two benchmark problems consisting of vehicle systems of differing complexity to assess the certificate quality of different synthesis methods and their effectiveness in safety-critical control. We use these benchmarks to compare various methods and provide practical guidance for selecting an approach.
items.abstract_zh: 安全是现代自主系统的核心关注点。安全证书——其存在保证系统满足安全规范的函数——长期以来一直被用作严格推理安全的原则性工具。用于合成此类证书的方法分散在各个研究领域，关于何时使用特定方法的指导很少。本教程以两个广泛使用的方法族为中心，对安全证书合成进行整体性处理：Hamilton–Jacobi（HJ）可达性分析和控制屏障函数（CBF）。对于每个方法族，我们首先介绍其一般形式，以及用于证书合成的经典工具和基于学习的工具。接下来，我们介绍两个由不同复杂度车辆系统组成的基准问题，以评估不同合成方法的证书质量及其在安全关键控制中的有效性。我们使用这些基准比较各种方法，并为选择方法提供实用指导。

items.title_en: Dual Architecture Fusion Vehicle Lidar 3D Target Detection
items.title_zh: 双架构融合的车载激光雷达三维目标检测
items.abstract_en: In this paper, a 3D backbone network (SpconvTransformer) based on the fusion of convolutional architecture branch and Transformer architecture branch is proposed. The convolution branch uses 3D sparse convolution and submanifold convolution to learn local voxel features and semantic information, and the Transformer branch uses the self-attention mechanism to model the remote relationship between voxels, uses the broad receptive field to capture rich context information, and complementing the advantages of the two architectures by fusing the local features extracted from the two branches and the global features solves the problem of limited receptive fields of 3D convolutional neural networks. The experimental results show that the average accuracy of SpconvTransformer in 3D object detection and bird's-eye view detection tasks reaches 81.45% and 88.09%, respectively, and the average directional similarity reaches 91.10%, which is significantly better than other existing algorithms.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于卷积架构分支与 Transformer 架构分支融合的 3D 主干网络（SpconvTransformer）。卷积分支使用 3D 稀疏卷积和子流形卷积学习局部体素特征与语义信息，Transformer 分支使用自注意力机制建模体素间的远距离关系，利用大感受野捕获丰富的上下文信息，并通过融合两个分支提取的局部特征与全局特征来互补两种架构的优势，解决了 3D 卷积神经网络感受野有限的问题。实验结果表明，SpconvTransformer 在 3D 目标检测和鸟瞰图检测任务上的平均精度分别达到 81.45% 和 88.09%，平均方向相似度达到 91.10%，显著优于其他现有算法。

items.title_en: Stress-adapted endophytic Pseudomonas strains isolated from unmanaged lupin promote potato growth and suppress verticillium wilt through complementary biocontrol and plant growth-promoting mechanisms
items.title_zh: 从未经管理的羽扇豆中分离的逆境适应型内生假单胞菌菌株通过互补的生物防治和植物促生机制促进马铃薯生长并抑制黄萎病
items.abstract_en: Verticillium wilt, primarily caused by Verticillium dahliae, is among the most destructive soil borne diseases impacting global potato production. Fungal propagules remain viable in soil for extended periods, and conventional control measures often show limited efficacy. These challenges underscore the necessity for sustainable disease management strategies. We evaluated two stress adapted endophytic Pseudomonas strains, B18 and B14, isolated from unmanaged wild Lupinus roots in Quebec, Canada, for their plant growth promoting and biocontrol potential against Verticillium wilt in potato. Both isolates exhibited multiple plant beneficial traits. B18 demonstrated strong phosphate solubilization, indole 3 acetic acid production, putative nitrogen fixation related activity, siderophore production, and hydrogen cyanide production. These traits correlated with enhanced plant growth promoting effects, including stimulation of seed germination and radicle growth. In contrast, B14 primarily exhibited antagonistic activity against Verticillium species through similar plant beneficial mechanisms, indicating complementary activities between the strains. The cell free supernatants of B18 further supported its biostimulant activity, suggesting a significant role for its extracellular metabolites. Greenhouse experiments using the Verticillium susceptible potato cultivar Russet Burbank, inoculated with either strain, showed enhanced plant growth and reduced disease severity compared with pathogen only controls. Under pathogen challenge, plants treated with plant growth promoting rhizobacteria (PGPR) exhibited up to 62% greater shoot height and approximately double the leaf production. Additionally, these plants produced 4.2 times more tubers than pathogen only plants. Disease progression, measured as the area under the disease progress curve (AUDPC), was reduced by 84 to 92% following bacterial inoculation. While individual strains effectively suppressed disease, the combined B18 plus B14 strains resulted in the most substantial improvements in growth, biomass, root development, and tuber production. These findings demonstrate that stress adapted endophytic Pseudomonas strains from wild Lupinus can contribute to sustainable potato production. The B18 plus B14 consortium, when combined with two-strain inoculation, demonstrated the most significant effects. These findings emphasize the potential of functionally complementary microbial inoculants for the integrated management of Verticillium wilt and other persistent soil-borne diseases in potatoes.
items.abstract_zh: 黄萎病主要由大丽轮枝菌（Verticillium dahliae）引起，是影响全球马铃薯生产的最具破坏性的土传病害之一。真菌繁殖体可在土壤中长时间保持活力，而常规防治措施往往效果有限。这些挑战凸显了可持续病害管理策略的必要性。我们评估了从加拿大魁北克未经管理的野生羽扇豆（Lupinus）根系中分离的两株逆境适应型内生假单胞菌菌株 B18 和 B14 对马铃薯黄萎病的植物促生和生物防治潜力。两株分离菌均表现出多种植物有益性状。B18 表现出较强的溶磷、吲哚-3-乙酸产生、推定的固氮相关活性、铁载体产生和氰化氢产生能力。这些性状与增强的植物促生效应相关，包括促进种子萌发和胚根生长。相比之下，B14 主要通过类似的植物有益机制表现出对轮枝菌属（Verticillium）的拮抗活性，表明两株菌之间存在互补活性。B18 的无细胞上清液进一步支持其生物刺激活性，表明其胞外代谢物发挥重要作用。使用黄萎病易感马铃薯品种 Russet Burbank 的温室实验表明，与仅接种病原菌的对照相比，接种任一菌株的植株生长增强且病害严重度降低。在病原菌挑战下，经植物促生根际细菌（PGPR）处理的植株株高最多增加 62%，叶片数量约增加一倍。此外，这些植株产生的块茎数量是仅接种病原菌植株的 4.2 倍。以病情进展曲线下面积（AUDPC）衡量的病害进展在细菌接种后降低 84% 至 92%。虽然单株菌均能有效抑制病害，但 B18 与 B14 联合处理在生长、生物量、根系发育和块茎产量方面改善最为显著。这些发现表明，来自野生羽扇豆的逆境适应型内生假单胞菌菌株可为可持续马铃薯生产作出贡献。B18 与 B14 联合体在双菌株接种时表现出最显著的效果。这些发现强调了功能互补的微生物接种剂在马铃薯黄萎病及其他持久性土传病害综合治理中的潜力。

items.title_en: A Passive Intelligent Metasurface: A Network Model
items.title_zh: 无源智能超表面：一种网络模型
items.abstract_en: Intelligent metasurfaces enable advanced wave manipulation, including negative refraction, focusing, beam splitting and beam steering, with significant potential for practical applications. However, conventional approaches often rely on active metamaterials with gain, or demand computationally intensive solutions of inverse problems to find the optimal configuration. In this work, we use the scattering framework of quantum graph theory to derive an exact, analytic expression for configuration of a passive metasurface that produces a prescribed reflected wave field. The metasurface terminates a periodic lattice of waveguides and consists of an array of channels, each a tube of length $\ell_m$ ending in a vertex whose scattering parameter $λ_m$ sets how much of the wave is lost to the wall. For any prescribed incident and reflected field, the exact lengths and scattering parameters follow channel by channel, in closed form, from the ratio of the wave amplitudes returning to and leaving the lattice, and the metasurface is passive whenever this ratio does not exceed unity in modulus. We demonstrate the construction for both a one-dimensional and a two-dimensional metasurface. The one-dimensional metasurface terminates a two-dimensional lattice and steers, splits or perfectly absorbs Gaussian beams. The two-dimensional metasurface terminates a three-dimensional lattice and generates a prescribed image in a plane inside the lattice. In each case, we obtain the exact boundary properties that produce the effect.
items.abstract_zh: 智能超表面可实现先进的波操控，包括负折射、聚焦、分束和波束偏转，具有重要的实际应用潜力。然而，传统方法通常依赖具有增益的有源超材料，或需要计算密集的逆问题求解来寻找最优配置。在本工作中，我们使用量子图论的散射框架，推导出可产生指定反射波场的无源超表面配置的精确解析表达式。该超表面端接波导的周期晶格，并由通道阵列组成，每个通道是一根长度为 ℓ_m 的管，末端为一个顶点，其散射参数 λ_m 决定有多少波损失到壁。对于任意指定的入射场和反射场，精确的长度和散射参数可逐通道地以闭式形式由返回晶格与离开晶格的波幅之比得到，且只要该比的模不超过 1，超表面即为无源。我们展示了一维和二维超表面的构造。一维超表面端接二维晶格，并对高斯光束进行偏转、分束或完美吸收。二维超表面端接三维晶格，并在晶格内部的平面上生成指定图像。在每种情况下，我们都获得了产生该效应的精确边界属性。

items.title_en: Static Recovery Is Not Dynamic Stability: Dynamics-Aware Benchmarking of Protein Motif Scaffolding
items.title_zh: 静态恢复不是动态稳定性：蛋白质基序支架设计的动力学感知基准测试
items.abstract_en: Protein motif scaffolding benchmarks assess whether generative models can build scaffolds around functionally important residues. Their conclusions depend on which motifs are tested and which criteria define success. Existing benchmarks typically use small hand-curated motif sets and static refolding criteria, but protein function often depends on conformational ensembles and transitions. Here, we address both benchmark scope and success criteria. We introduce BILBY-PRO, a systematically derived benchmark of structurally conserved functional motifs from PROSITE-linked experimental structures, comprising 220 cases from 174 PROSITE motif-pattern entries. Evaluating six recent scaffold-generation models reveals distinct patterns in target coverage and unique-solution yield: RFDiffusion and Proteina solve more targets, whereas ESM3 produces more unique successful scaffolds on the targets it solves. We further introduce BILBY-MD, a reference-based all-atom molecular dynamics evaluation framework. Applied to statically solved designs from the original MotifBench benchmark, it compares motif drift, scaffold drift, motif-contact preservation, and motif-dihedral free-energy landscapes against reference simulations. Of 55 statically solved model-problem pairs, 31 satisfy our MD-supported criterion and only 8 pass all checks. Compact, self-contained motifs are often MD-supported, whereas interface-like or context-dependent motifs fail more frequently. Static refolding success therefore provides useful evidence of local motif recovery but does not establish dynamical fidelity of the full scaffold. BILBY highlights three complementary axes of motif-scaffolding evaluation: target coverage, unique-solution yield, and MD-supported dynamical fidelity.
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质基序支架设计基准评估生成模型能否围绕功能重要残基构建支架。其结论取决于测试哪些基序以及哪些标准定义成功。现有基准通常使用小型手工整理的基序集和静态重折叠标准，但蛋白质功能往往依赖构象系综和转变。在此，我们同时处理基准范围和成功标准。我们引入 BILBY-PRO，这是一个从与 PROSITE 关联的实验结构中系统推导的结构保守功能基序基准，包含来自 174 个 PROSITE 基序模式条目的 220 个案例。评估六个近期支架生成模型揭示了在目标覆盖率和唯一解产出率上的不同模式：RFDiffusion 和 Proteina 解决更多目标，而 ESM3 在其解决的目标上产生更多唯一成功支架。我们进一步引入 BILBY-MD，一个基于参考的全原子分子动力学评估框架。将其应用于来自原始 MotifBench 基准的静态求解设计，它比较基序漂移、支架漂移、基序接触保持以及基序二面角自由能景观与参考模拟的差异。在 55 个静态求解的模型-问题对中，31 个满足我们 MD 支持的标准，仅 8 个通过所有检查。紧凑、自包含的基序通常获得 MD 支持，而类似界面或依赖上下文的基序更常失败。因此，静态重折叠成功为局部基序恢复提供了有用证据，但不能确立完整支架的动力学保真度。BILBY 突出了基序支架评估的三个互补轴：目标覆盖率、唯一解产出率和 MD 支持的动力学保真度。

items.title_en: RuACT: Recovering Inactive Rubrics as Adaptive Critics and Teachers
items.title_zh: RuACT：将非活跃评分细则恢复为自适应评判者与教师
items.abstract_en: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) extends RL with verifiable rewards to open-ended tasks by scoring each response against query-specific rubrics. Under group-relative optimization, however, a rubric that every sampled response fails (unreachable) or passes (saturated) gives all responses the same outcome and no learning signal; in Qwen3-4B medical training, 60.88% of query-rubric observations are inactive. We find that the two states lack different supervision: stating an unreachable rubric in the prompt raises its satisfaction from 1.13% to 91.25%, whereas responses that all pass a saturated rubric still differ in quality. We therefore propose RuACT (Rubrics as Adaptive Critics and Teachers), which assigns each inactive rubric the role that supplies what it lacks. Rubric as Teacher uses unreachable rubrics as privileged information for reward-gated on-policy self-distillation, and Rubric as Critic decomposes saturated rubrics into child rubrics that separate current responses while sharing the parent's weight. RuACT outperforms GRPO, rubric reweighting, and rubric-guided exploration on all four medical and scientific benchmarks with Qwen3-4B and achieves the best average with Qwen3-1.7B. On initially unreachable rubrics, unguided recovery rises from 35.02% to 42.86%, while child refinement improves reward-quality alignment on independent rollouts from 57.74% to 60.77%. Code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/RuACT.
items.abstract_zh: 基于评分细则的强化学习（RL）通过根据查询特定的评分细则对每个响应评分，将带可验证奖励的强化学习扩展到开放式任务。然而，在组相对优化下，所有采样响应都失败（不可达）或都通过（饱和）的评分细则会给所有响应相同的结果，不提供学习信号；在 Qwen3-4B 医学训练中，60.88% 的查询-评分细则观测为非活跃。我们发现这两种状态缺乏不同的监督：在提示中陈述不可达评分细则可将其满足率从 1.13% 提高到 91.25%，而所有响应都通过饱和评分细则时，响应质量仍然存在差异。因此，我们提出 RuACT（Rubrics as Adaptive Critics and Teachers），为每个非活跃评分细则分配能够提供其所缺内容的角色。Rubric as Teacher 将不可达评分细则用作特权信息，用于奖励门控的在线策略自蒸馏；Rubric as Critic 将饱和评分细则分解为子评分细则，在分离当前响应的同时共享父评分细则的权重。RuACT 在 Qwen3-4B 上于全部四个医学与科学基准上优于 GRPO、评分细则重加权和评分细则引导探索，并在 Qwen3-1.7B 上取得最佳平均值。在初始不可达评分细则上，无引导恢复率从 35.02% 提高到 42.86%，而子评分细则细化将独立 rollout 上的奖励-质量对齐从 57.74% 提高到 60.77%。代码见 https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/RuACT。

items.title_en: FREE-LIVO: Physically Decoupled Yet Tightly Coupled LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry
items.title_zh: FREE-LIVO：物理解耦但紧耦合的激光雷达-惯性-视觉里程计
items.abstract_en: LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry (LIVO) integrates complementary LiDAR, camera, and IMU measurements to achieve robust state estimation. However, most existing methods assume a fixed relative pose and accurate time synchronization between sensors. Toward modular and heterogeneous robotic systems, this paper presents FREE-LIVO, a tightly coupled odometry method that requires neither a rigid LiDAR-camera rig nor LiDAR-camera time synchronization. The proposed method uses a pretrained image feature matcher to establish correspondences between a camera image and a dense LiDAR intensity image generated from a single LiDAR scan using a generative model. From the resulting 3D point-to-pixel correspondences, we construct reprojection factors that directly constrain LiDAR and camera poses at different acquisition times. These factors are jointly optimized in a single factor graph together with constraints from point cloud registration, visual feature tracking, and the IMU measurements associated with each sensor. On six sequences from the public M3DGR dataset, FREE-LIVO achieves an average absolute trajectory error (ATE) RMSE of 0.45 m without provided LiDAR-camera extrinsic parameters and exhibits minimal accuracy degradation under time synchronization errors of up to 0.5 s. Furthermore, experiments with the LiDAR and camera mounted on separate robots demonstrate that the method can jointly estimate the trajectories of independently moving sensors.
items.abstract_zh: 激光雷达-惯性-视觉里程计（LIVO）融合互补的激光雷达、相机和 IMU 测量以实现稳健的状态估计。然而，大多数现有方法假设传感器之间具有固定的相对位姿和精确的时间同步。面向模块化和异构机器人系统，本文提出 FREE-LIVO，一种既不需要刚性激光雷达-相机装置也不需要激光雷达-相机时间同步的紧耦合里程计方法。所提方法使用预训练图像特征匹配器，在相机图像与使用生成模型由单次激光雷达扫描生成的稠密激光雷达强度图像之间建立对应关系。根据得到的三维点-像素对应关系，我们构建重投影因子，直接约束不同采集时刻的激光雷达和相机位姿。这些因子与来自点云配准、视觉特征跟踪以及每个传感器相关 IMU 测量的约束一起，在单一因子图中联合优化。在公开 M3DGR 数据集的六个序列上，FREE-LIVO 在未提供激光雷达-相机外参的情况下取得 0.45 m 的平均绝对轨迹误差（ATE）RMSE，并在高达 0.5 s 的时间同步误差下表现出极小的精度下降。此外，将激光雷达和相机安装在独立机器人上的实验表明，该方法能够联合估计独立运动传感器的轨迹。

items.title_en: HiMEM: Hippocampus-Inspired Memory Consolidation, Pruning, and Composition for Vision-Language-Action Models in 3D Scenes
items.title_zh: HiMEM：面向三维场景中视觉-语言-动作模型的受海马体启发的记忆巩固、剪枝与组合
items.abstract_en: Memory plays a crucial role in long-horizon task execution and cross-task generalization for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models operating in complex 3D scenes. However, existing VLA memory mechanisms suffer from memory noise, particularly in complex 3D scenes, as stored episodic memories contain extensive redundant details about scene layouts, object configurations, and robot-specific states, which obscure generalizable manipulation principles and hinder cross-task transfer. To address this challenge, we first introduce a hippocampus-inspired memory consolidation mechanism that synthesizes extensive episodic experiences into a compact set of essential semantic memories, enabling VLA models to derive generalizable principles from practical experience. Second, we propose an episodic memory pruning mechanism that removes redundant episodic memories whose contents are captured by consolidated semantic memories, thereby increasing effective memory capacity and improving long-horizon task execution. Finally, to handle complex task scenarios, we develop a flexible memory composition mechanism that jointly leverages multiple episodic and semantic memories to enhance cross-scenario generalization. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus demonstrate the effectiveness of HiMEM across different VLA backbones, improving the average success rate of pi_0 from 91.88% to 98.20% on LIBERO.
items.abstract_zh: 记忆对于在复杂三维场景中运行的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的长时程任务执行和跨任务泛化起着至关重要的作用。然而，现有VLA记忆机制受到记忆噪声的影响，尤其是在复杂三维场景中，因为存储的情景记忆包含大量关于场景布局、物体配置和机器人特定状态的冗余细节，这些细节掩盖了可泛化的操作原理并阻碍跨任务迁移。为应对这一挑战，我们首先引入一种受海马体启发的记忆巩固机制，该机制将大量情景经验综合为一组紧凑的关键语义记忆，使VLA模型能够从实际经验中提炼可泛化的原理。其次，我们提出一种情景记忆剪枝机制，该机制移除内容已被巩固后的语义记忆所捕获的冗余情景记忆，从而提高有效记忆容量并改善长时程任务执行。最后，为处理复杂任务场景，我们开发了一种灵活的记忆组合机制，该机制联合利用多个情景记忆和语义记忆来增强跨场景泛化能力。在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus上的实验证明了HiMEM在不同VLA主干网络上的有效性，在LIBERO上将pi_0的平均成功率从91.88%提高到98.20%。

items.title_en: Targeted Deletions Uncover Previously Uncharacterised C1-fixing Cluster Genes as Essential for Autotrophy in Clostridium autoethanogenum
items.title_zh: 靶向缺失揭示此前未表征的C1固定簇基因是Clostridium autoethanogenum自养所必需的
items.abstract_en: Recycling carbon oxides from industrial off-gases and gasified organic waste using gas fermentation offers a sustainable route for biomanufacturing of fuels and chemicals. Acetogens are attractive biocatalysts here and fix CO and CO2 via the Wood-Ljungdahl pathway (WLP). However, the incomplete functional annotation of the associated C1-fixing gene cluster limits rational engineering of acetogen cell factories. Here, we investigated five highly conserved but previously uncharacterised C1-fixing cluster genes to quantify their contributions to the growth of the model-acetogen Clostridium autoethanogenum using targeted CRISPR/Cas9-mediated single-gene deletions, physiological characterisation, comparative computational structural analyses, CRISPRi, and functional genomics. Importantly, we identified acsV, lpdA, cooC, and cooC2 as essential for autotrophy but not heterotrophy, whereas deletion of gcvH reduced autotrophic growth and shifted carbon flux from acetate towards 2,3-butanediol. Amino acid supplementation experiments and computational analyses indicate that lpdA and gcvH do not primarily function in glycine or serine biosynthesis but instead fulfil specialised roles in WLP-associated C1 and redox metabolism. Furthermore, genetic and physiological analyses showed that the two CooC-family ATPases, CooC and CooC2, have non-redundant roles in growth, with only cooC2 deletion impairing heterotrophy. Acetate supplementation tests revealed that {Delta}acsV cells retained metabolic activity despite abolished autotrophy, and computational analyses suggest a likely role for acsV in ATP-dependent corrinoid activation. Surprisingly, CRISPRi-mediated repression of acsV was translationally buffered, resulting in altered carbon partitioning without impairing autotrophy. Together, our findings provide insights into the physiological importance of the C1-fixing cluster genes in acetogens and support their metabolic engineering as gas-fermenting cell factories.
items.abstract_zh: 利用气体发酵回收工业尾气和气化有机废物中的碳氧化物，为燃料和化学品的生物制造提供了一条可持续途径。产乙酸菌是这方面有吸引力的生物催化剂，并通过Wood-Ljungdahl途径（WLP）固定CO和CO2。然而，相关C1固定基因簇的功能注释不完整，限制了产乙酸菌细胞工厂的理性工程改造。在此，我们研究了五个高度保守但此前未表征的C1固定簇基因，利用靶向CRISPR/Cas9介导的单基因缺失、生理表征、比较计算结构分析、CRISPRi和功能基因组学，量化它们对模式产乙酸菌Clostridium autoethanogenum生长的贡献。重要的是，我们确定acsV、lpdA、cooC和cooC2对自养必需，但对异养并非必需，而gcvH的缺失降低了自养生长并使碳通量从乙酸转向2,3-丁二醇。氨基酸补充实验和计算分析表明，lpdA和gcvH主要并不发挥甘氨酸或丝氨酸生物合成功能，而是在与WLP相关的C1和氧化还原代谢中发挥专门作用。此外，遗传和生理分析显示，两个CooC家族ATP酶CooC和CooC2在生长中具有非冗余作用，只有cooC2缺失会损害异养。乙酸补充实验揭示，ΔacsV细胞尽管自养被废除，但仍保留代谢活性；计算分析提示acsV可能在ATP依赖性类咕啉激活中发挥作用。令人惊讶的是，CRISPRi介导的acsV抑制在翻译层面受到缓冲，导致碳分配改变而不损害自养。总之，我们的发现为C1固定簇基因在产乙酸菌中的生理重要性提供了见解，并支持将其代谢工程改造为气体发酵细胞工厂。

items.title_en: Raman anyon-Hubbard model in a 1D Bose lattice gas
items.title_zh: 一维玻色晶格气体中的拉曼任意子-Hubbard模型
items.abstract_en: The anyon-Hubbard model is the paradigmatic lattice model of one-dimensional (1D) anyons, in which chiral interactions make bosons equivalent to particles with fractional statistics. Its continuum limit, the chiral BF theory, emerges as the low-energy description of a Raman-coupled Bose gas with imbalanced interactions. Here, we show that loading such a gas into a 1D optical lattice realizes the lattice counterpart of this theory, which we name the Raman anyon-Hubbard model. The Raman-dressed bosons acquire density-dependent Peierls phases when tunneling through occupied sites. For a small statistical phase, the model reduces to the anyon-Hubbard model, while beyond this limit it defines a distinct lattice anyon model with unbounded rather than periodic statistical interactions. Numerically, we show that the dressed gas displays the defining properties of 1D anyons, namely a density-dependent asymmetry of the ground-state momentum distribution, interaction-induced asymmetric transport and chiral bound states. Remarkably, these features are readily accessible with Raman-coupled $^{39}$K atoms, opening up the experimental exploration of 1D anyons beyond the few-particle regime.
items.abstract_zh: 任意子-Hubbard模型是一维（1D）任意子的典型晶格模型，其中手性相互作用使玻色子等效于具有分数统计的粒子。其连续极限，即手性BF理论，作为具有不平衡相互作用的拉曼耦合玻色气体的低能描述出现。在此，我们表明将这种气体加载到一维光晶格中实现了该理论的晶格对应物，我们将其命名为拉曼任意子-Hubbard模型。拉曼缀饰的玻色子在隧穿通过被占据格点时获得密度依赖的Peierls相位。对于小的统计相位，该模型退化为任意子-Hubbard模型；而超出此极限时，它定义了一种不同的晶格任意子模型，其统计相互作用是无界的而非周期的。在数值上，我们表明该缀饰气体表现出一维任意子的定义性性质，即基态动量分布的密度依赖不对称性、相互作用诱导的不对称输运以及手性束缚态。值得注意的是，这些特征很容易用拉曼耦合的$^{39}$K原子实现，从而开启了超出少粒子情形的一维任意子实验探索。

items.title_en: CoMoFlow: Controllable Protein Conformational Ensemble Generation via Explicit Collective-Mode Modeling
items.title_zh: CoMoFlow：通过显式集体模式建模生成可控蛋白质构象集合
items.abstract_en: Protein conformational ensemble generation aims to efficiently characterize the structural variations accessible to a protein beyond a single static structure. Recent flow-based methods efficiently generate conformational ensembles, but they model coordinated structural variation implicitly, which can limit ensemble fidelity and hinder direct control. To address this limitation, we propose CoMoFlow, a controllable framework for generating protein backbone conformational ensembles by explicitly modeling collective variation. CoMoFlow constructs protein-specific collective modes from the equilibrium structure, learns the distribution of their coefficients across the molecular dynamics (MD) ensemble, and uses sampled collective variations to guide SE(3) flow matching through feature conditioning and prior recentering. Experiments on ATLAS and de novo proteins show that CoMoFlow improves reconstruction of MD conformational distributions and coordinated structural variation relative to strong flow-based baselines, while enabling direct control over targeted conformational changes.
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质构象集合生成旨在高效表征蛋白质在单一静态结构之外可及的结构变化。近期基于流的方法能够高效生成构象集合，但它们隐式地建模协调的结构变化，这可能限制集合保真度并阻碍直接控制。为解决这一局限，我们提出CoMoFlow，一个通过显式建模集体变化来生成蛋白质主链构象集合的可控框架。CoMoFlow从平衡结构构建蛋白质特异性集体模式，学习其系数在分子动力学（MD）集合上的分布，并使用采样的集体变化通过特征条件化和先验重新居中来引导SE(3)流匹配。在ATLAS和de novo蛋白质上的实验表明，相对于强基于流的基线，CoMoFlow改善了对MD构象分布和协调结构变化的重建，同时能够直接控制目标构象变化。

items.title_en: An Effective Spoken Language Understanding Approach Leveraging Query-Adaptive Intent Detection
items.title_zh: 一种利用查询自适应意图检测的有效口语理解方法
items.abstract_en: Large language models enable fine-tuning-free spoken language understanding (SLU) through in-context learning, but direct query-based retrieval may select semantically similar yet intent irrelevant demonstrations. This paper presents Query-Adaptive Intent Detection via Prototype Extraction (APEX), a two-stage retrieval framework that first selects candidate intents using intent-level prototypes and then retrieves contextual exemplars within the selected intent space. Experiments on the SLURP dataset evaluate joint SLU performance using Exact Match Accuracy (EMA) under full-transcript and perplexity-stratified conditions, with additional retrieval analysis on ASR-generated transcripts. Compared with query-based retrieval, APEX improves EMA by 4.34 and 3.97 percentage points with Qwen3 4B and Gemma-3-4B, respectively, on full transcripts. Under high-perplexity inputs, APEX also yields EMA gains of 7.66 and 2.13 percentage points. Retrieval analysis further indicates that prototype-guided candidate selection achieves higher ground truth intent coverage across multiple input conditions.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型通过上下文学习实现了免微调的口语理解（SLU），但直接基于查询的检索可能选择语义相似却与意图无关的示例。本文提出通过原型提取的查询自适应意图检测（APEX），这是一个两阶段检索框架，首先使用意图级原型选择候选意图，然后在所选意图空间内检索上下文示例。在SLURP数据集上的实验在完整转录文本和按困惑度分层条件下使用精确匹配准确率（EMA）评估联合SLU性能，并对ASR生成的转录文本进行额外的检索分析。与基于查询的检索相比，在完整转录文本上，APEX在使用Qwen3 4B和Gemma-3-4B时分别将EMA提高了4.34和3.97个百分点。在高困惑度输入下，APEX还分别带来7.66和2.13个百分点的EMA提升。检索分析进一步表明，原型引导的候选选择在多种输入条件下实现了更高的真实意图覆盖率。

items.title_en: Scenario Orchestration for Closed-loop Policy Evaluation of Autonomous Driving
items.title_zh: 用于自动驾驶闭环策略评估的场景编排
items.abstract_en: Scenario-based simulation is central to evaluating autonomous-driving policies, but a scenario scripted before execution (i.e., with predetermined, fixed actor routes and speeds) may not preserve its intended interaction once the tested ego policy responds in closed loop. Scripted scenarios cannot adapt to unanticipated ego behavior, while learned traffic actors may remain reactive without reliably realizing a particular scenario intent. We introduce a scenario orchestrator that continuously monitors the joint traffic state and adapts non-ego actors through re-timing, re-routing, and role reassignment for creating a specific scenario intent. At each step, the orchestrator solves a constrained optimization problem that preserves the intended interaction while limiting interventions and maintaining traffic feasibility. We further distinguish scenario realization from policy failure, allowing a test to first be judged based on whether the intended interaction occurred and then by how the ego policy responded. Experiments in the CARLA simulator across multiple scenario families and driving policies show that orchestration realizes targeted interactions more reliably than scripted and learned actor-level baselines, particularly under variations in initial conditions and ego behavior. These results support closed-loop scenario orchestration as a tool for controlled and reproducible policy evaluation.
items.abstract_zh: 基于场景的仿真对于评估自动驾驶策略至关重要，但在执行前脚本化设定的场景（即具有预定的固定参与者路线和速度）在被测自车策略以闭环方式响应后，可能无法保持其预期的交互。脚本化场景无法适应未预料的自车行为，而学习得到的交通参与者可能保持反应性，却不能可靠地实现特定场景意图。我们引入一种场景编排器，它持续监测联合交通状态，并通过重新定时、重新路由和角色重新分配来调整非自车参与者，以创建特定场景意图。在每一步，编排器求解一个约束优化问题，在保持预期交互的同时限制干预并维持交通可行性。我们进一步区分场景实现与策略失败，使测试首先根据预期交互是否发生来评判，然后根据自车策略如何响应来评判。在CARLA模拟器中跨多个场景族和驾驶策略的实验表明，编排比脚本化和学习的参与者级基线更可靠地实现目标交互，尤其是在初始条件和自车行为变化的情况下。这些结果支持将闭环场景编排作为受控且可重复的策略评估工具。

items.title_en: A Theoretical Analysis of a Bilevel Optimization Formulation for Combined Local-Global Optical Flow Models
items.title_zh: 组合局部-全局光流模型的双层优化表述的理论分析
items.abstract_en: This paper analyzes a bilevel formulation for learning the regularization parameter of combined local-global (CLG) optical flow models. The lower-level problem computes the flow from a Lucas--Kanade data term and a quadratic or total variation (TV) regularizer, and the upper-level problem selects the parameter that minimizes the squared distance to a ground-truth flow. The setting is finite-dimensional, and a full-rank assumption makes the lower-level solution unique. For the quadratic model we derive sufficient conditions for the existence of an optimal parameter, for every optimal parameter to be positive, and for strict local optimality. For TV regularization an optimal parameter always exists, because the lower-level solution vanishes for large parameters, and we give a sufficient condition for positivity that accounts for the coupling of the two flow components through the local structure tensors. Synthetic examples illustrate the conditions, including cases in which they fail.
items.abstract_zh: 本文分析了一种用于学习组合局部-全局（CLG）光流模型正则化参数的双层表述。下层问题从 Lucas--Kanade 数据项和二次或全变分（TV）正则化项计算光流，上层问题选择使与真实光流平方距离最小化的参数。该设定是有限维的，满秩假设使下层解唯一。对于二次模型，我们推导了最优参数存在、每个最优参数均为正以及严格局部最优的充分条件。对于 TV 正则化，最优参数总是存在，因为当下层参数较大时下层解消失；我们给出了一个考虑两个光流分量通过局部结构张量耦合的正性充分条件。合成示例说明了这些条件，包括它们失效的情形。

items.title_en: Mucin promotes pneumococcal colonization via autolysis suppression and tryptophan-mediated immune modulation
items.title_zh: 黏蛋白通过抑制自溶和色氨酸介导的免疫调节促进肺炎球菌定植
items.abstract_en: Streptococcus pneumoniae is a leading human respiratory pathogen, yet its success depends not on disease but on its ability to persist as an asymptomatic colonizer of the nasopharynx. The nasopharyngeal mucosa is lined with mucus, whose heavily O-glycosylated mucin proteins are the most abundant macromolecules in the pneumococcal natural niche. While mucus is canonically viewed as a host defense barrier, we found that mucin actively reprograms pneumococcal physiology to promote colonization through two distinct mechanisms. First, mucin suppresses pneumococcal autolysis by specifically inhibiting the enzymatic activity of the major autolysin LytA, prolonging bacterial survival and restricting release of the cholesterol-dependent cytotoxin pneumolysin, thereby reducing host cell damage. Second, mucin induces de novo biosynthesis and extracellular release of tryptophan, an essential amino acid that humans cannot synthesize and that serves as a substrate for host immunomodulatory pathways. Tryptophan biosynthesis was critical for pneumococcal survival against macrophage killing, and its disruption abolished both colonization and invasive disease. Transcriptomic analysis revealed that tryptophan biosynthesis enables the pneumococcus to survive a bactericidal macrophage state while preventing macrophage transition to proliferative tissue repair. Together, these findings reveal that mucin is not merely a barrier but an active signal that reprograms the pneumococcus toward a persistent, host-tolerant state, identifying a distinctive repertoire of colonization mechanisms that allow a virulent respiratory pathogen to sustain long-term asymptomatic carriage in its human reservoir.
items.abstract_zh: 肺炎链球菌是主要的人类呼吸道病原体，但其成功并不取决于致病，而取决于其作为鼻咽部无症状定植者持续存在的能力。鼻咽黏膜表面覆盖着黏液，其中高度 O-糖基化的黏蛋白是肺炎球菌天然生态位中最丰富的大分子。虽然黏液通常被视为宿主防御屏障，但我们发现黏蛋白通过两种不同机制主动重编程肺炎球菌生理以促进定植。首先，黏蛋白通过特异性抑制主要自溶素 LytA 的酶活性来抑制肺炎球菌自溶，延长细菌存活并限制胆固醇依赖性细胞毒素肺炎球菌溶血素的释放，从而减少宿主细胞损伤。其次，黏蛋白诱导色氨酸的从头生物合成和胞外释放；色氨酸是人类无法合成的必需氨基酸，并作为宿主免疫调节通路的底物。色氨酸生物合成对于肺炎球菌抵抗巨噬细胞杀伤的存活至关重要，其破坏消除了定植和侵袭性疾病。转录组分析显示，色氨酸生物合成使肺炎球菌能够在杀菌性巨噬细胞状态下存活，同时阻止巨噬细胞向增殖性组织修复转变。总之，这些发现表明黏蛋白不仅是屏障，而且是主动信号，将肺炎球菌重编程为持续、宿主耐受的状态，识别出一组独特的定植机制，使一种强毒呼吸道病原体能够在其人类储存库中维持长期无症状携带。

items.title_en: Discovering formally verified quantum programs with AI
items.title_zh: 利用人工智能发现经形式化验证的量子程序
items.abstract_en: The timeline by which quantum computers can solve breakthrough problems in science depends on improved quantum algorithms as much as on better hardware. Such algorithmic advances are typically achieved through many years of expert human collaboration. In mathematics and computer science, large language models have accelerated progress through automated discovery loops. However, quantum algorithms can only be evaluated by classical computers on restricted or small instances. Here we demonstrate automated discovery of quantum programs beyond these regimes including order-of-magnitude improvements on scientific applications. To achieve this, we build a quantum program library in the Lean theorem prover in which large language model agents synthesize novel programs against formal problem specifications and verify their correctness and cost. Agent teams collaborate, sharing results and knowledge through wikis and discussing ideas at organized conferences. Our results improve on prior baselines for parallel search (up to 1.4x), quantum arithmetic (290x), and simulations relevant to fusion, photochemistry and drug-metabolism by 11x, 8x and 2.5x respectively. Combining human and artificial intelligence at scale, under the rigor of mathematical proof, lets researchers design algorithms that today's classical and quantum computers cannot test, shortening the path to practical quantum computation.
items.abstract_zh: 量子计算机能够解决科学突破性问题的时间表，既取决于更好的硬件，也取决于改进的量子算法。此类算法进展通常通过多年的专家人类协作实现。在数学和计算机科学中，大语言模型通过自动化发现循环加速了进展。然而，量子算法只能由经典计算机在受限或小规模实例上评估。在这里，我们展示了在这些范围之外自动发现量子程序，包括在科学应用上实现数量级改进。为实现这一点，我们在 Lean 定理证明器中构建了一个量子程序库，其中大语言模型智能体针对形式化问题规范合成新程序，并验证其正确性和成本。智能体团队协作，通过维基共享结果和知识，并在组织的会议上讨论想法。我们的结果改进了先前的基线：并行搜索（最高 1.4 倍）、量子算术（290 倍），以及与聚变、光化学和药物代谢相关的模拟分别提高 11 倍、8 倍和 2.5 倍。在数学证明的严谨性下大规模结合人类和人工智能，使研究人员能够设计当今经典和量子计算机无法测试的算法，缩短通往实用量子计算的路径。

items.title_en: Bridging Spiking and Continuous Dynamics in Spiking Neural Networks: A Muscle-Inspired Model
items.title_zh: 弥合脉冲神经网络中脉冲与连续动力学：一种受肌肉启发的模型
items.abstract_en: Transforming the spike trains produced by spiking neural networks (SNNs) into continuous signals through biologically inspired mechanisms remains an open challenge in generative and regression tasks. In biological systems, a similar transformation occurs when muscles integrate neural spikes to produce smooth, coordinated movements. Inspired by this mechanism, we introduce a muscle-response model, a biologically motivated dynamical layer that converts spike trains into continuous representations. Our approach uses second-order dynamics to model the temporal integration of spiking activity. We investigate how the number of spiking neurons and temporal resolution affect the quality of the generated signals in a text-to-speech task, showing that increasing representational capacity has a greater impact than increasing temporal resolution under the evaluated configurations. Furthermore, an analysis of the learned dynamics reveals that, without explicit constraints on the response type, most neurons converge toward non-oscillatory behavior. These results demonstrate the potential of biologically inspired dynamical decoders for bridging spiking neural computation and continuous signal generation.
items.abstract_zh: 通过生物启发的机制将脉冲神经网络（SNN）产生的脉冲序列转换为连续信号，在生成和回归任务中仍是一个未解决的挑战。在生物系统中，当肌肉整合神经脉冲以产生平滑、协调的运动时，会发生类似的转换。受此机制启发，我们引入了一种肌肉响应模型，这是一种生物驱动的动态层，可将脉冲序列转换为连续表示。我们的方法使用二阶动力学来建模脉冲活动的时间整合。我们在文本到语音任务中研究了脉冲神经元数量和时间分辨率如何影响生成信号的质量，结果表明在所评估的配置下，增加表示容量比增加时间分辨率影响更大。此外，对学习到的动力学的分析表明，在没有对响应类型施加显式约束的情况下，大多数神经元收敛到非振荡行为。这些结果证明了生物启发动态解码器在弥合脉冲神经计算与连续信号生成方面的潜力。

items.title_en: Syn2DRE: Synergistic Dual Teacher-Student Framework for Document-level Relation Extraction
items.title_zh: Syn2DRE：用于文档级关系抽取的协同双师生框架
items.abstract_en: Document-level Relation Extraction (DocRE) aims to identify relations between entities across a document but typically relies on costly large-scale annotations. While pseudo-labelling enables the use of low-quality data, existing methods often suffer from inefficiency and confirmation bias. To address these challenges, we propose Syn2DRE, a semi-supervised framework that combines self-supervised learning with cross-supervision in a lightweight teacher-student architecture to produce more reliable pseudo-labels. Additionally, we introduce a unified end-to-end training strategy to further improve efficiency of the framework. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that Syn2DRE consistently outperforms prior state-of-the-art semi-supervised DocRE methods.
items.abstract_zh: 文档级关系抽取（DocRE）旨在识别文档中实体之间的关系，但通常依赖昂贵的大规模标注。伪标注能够利用低质量数据，但现有方法常常效率低下且存在确认偏差。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 Syn2DRE，一个半监督框架，它在轻量级师生架构中结合自监督学习与交叉监督，以产生更可靠的伪标签。此外，我们引入统一的端到端训练策略，以进一步提高该框架的效率。在多个基准上的实验表明，Syn2DRE 始终优于先前最先进的半监督 DocRE 方法。

items.title_en: Autonomous Particle Image Velocimetry Using Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 使用零样本仿真到现实强化学习的自主粒子图像测速
items.abstract_en: Particle image velocimetry (PIV) reconstructs a flow field from the motion of tracer particles but the reconstruction quality is bounded by how well the flow structure of interest is resolved in the images. The acquisition position is typically fixed by the operator before the measurement. We cast camera placement as a sequential decision-making problem and train a reinforcement learning agent to control a 6-DoF manipulator equipped with a camera, enabling it to locate, frame and resolve a hydrofoil wake in a water tunnel. The agent commands the camera pose and observes the scene only through the velocity field and uncertainty estimated from time-separated image pairs. It is trained entirely in a photorealistic simulation of our water tunnel, with wakes generated by Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulations of hydrofoils with varying profiles, positions and angles of attack. After zero-shot transfer to the real water tunnel, the policy reliably locates and frames the wakes of randomly placed hydrofoils. It resolves the wake at a higher resolution than a fixed camera view and with lower error in the measured flow statistics, in roughly half the time of a full scan and with far fewer image pairs.
items.abstract_zh: 粒子图像测速（PIV）根据示踪粒子的运动重建流场，但重建质量受限于图像中所关注流结构被解析的程度。采集位置通常由操作者在测量前固定。我们将相机放置建模为序贯决策问题，并训练一个强化学习智能体来控制配备相机的 6 自由度机械臂，使其能够在水洞中定位、取景并解析水翼尾流。智能体命令相机位姿，并且仅通过由时间分离图像对估计的速度场和不确定性观察场景。它完全在我们的水洞逼真仿真中训练，尾流由对不同翼型、位置和攻角的水翼进行计算流体力学（CFD）模拟生成。在零样本迁移到真实水洞后，该策略能够可靠地定位并取景随机放置水翼的尾流。与固定相机视角相比，它以更高分辨率解析尾流，并且测得流动统计量的误差更低；所用时间约为完整扫描的一半，且图像对数量少得多。

items.title_en: OmniLatent: Unified Latent for 3D Part Modeling
items.title_zh: OmniLatent：用于3D部件建模的统一潜变量
items.abstract_en: 3D part decomposition is a central capability for editable asset creation, yet existing workflows typically segment a completed mesh as a post-processing step, making the result sensitive to geometric artifacts, texture ambiguity, and limited part-level annotations. We present OmniLatent, a unified latent modeling framework for 3D part decomposition. Instead of predicting part labels in isolation, OmniLatent learns a shared latent space that jointly encodes geometry, deformation, appearance, and binary part IDs, allowing data-rich geometric and visual priors to support data-scarce part learning. Given a single input image, the base model generates geometry, deformation, texture, and surface part IDs in one pass, producing a part-aware 3D asset without a separate segmentation stage. We further tune the pretrained model for two extensions: a point-prompt adapter that maps arbitrary 3D point prompts with binary part IDs into latent tokens for full segmentation, refinement, and part subdivision, and an amodal part completion model that completes partial surface masks into a coherent full-object decomposition through dynamic per-part token allocation, cross-attention to the given geometry latent, and alternating part-local and global attention. Extensive experiments show that OmniLatent produces semantically meaningful part segmentations with precise boundaries, supports interactive part editing, and completes partial part observations while preserving global object consistency.
items.abstract_zh: 3D部件分解是可编辑资产创建的核心能力，但现有工作流通常将完成的网格作为后处理步骤进行分割，使结果对几何伪影、纹理歧义和有限的部件级标注敏感。我们提出OmniLatent，一个用于3D部件分解的统一潜变量建模框架。OmniLatent并非孤立地预测部件标签，而是学习一个共享潜空间，联合编码几何、变形、外观和二元部件ID，使数据丰富的几何与视觉先验能够支持数据稀缺的部件学习。给定单张输入图像，基础模型一次生成几何、变形、纹理和表面部件ID，无需单独的分割阶段即可生成部件感知的3D资产。我们进一步微调预训练模型以实现两个扩展：一个点提示适配器，将带有二元部件ID的任意3D点提示映射为潜变量token，用于完整分割、细化和部件再细分；以及一个非模态部件补全模型，通过动态逐部件token分配、对给定几何潜变量的交叉注意力以及交替的部件局部与全局注意力，将部分表面掩码补全为连贯的全对象分解。大量实验表明，OmniLatent产生具有精确边界的语义有意义的部件分割，支持交互式部件编辑，并在保持全局对象一致性的同时补全部分部件观测。

items.title_en: Rapid generation of marsupial induced pluripotent stem cells suitable for use in next-generation conservation
items.title_zh: 快速生成适用于下一代保护的有袋类诱导多能干细胞
items.abstract_en: Marsupials account for a disproportionate share of recent and impending mammalian extinctions, that has prompted investment in the development of "next generation" conservation biotechnologies. These include the generation of genetically selected/modified individuals for improved population fitness. Given the inherent limitations of working with threatened species, a flexible vehicle to develop these technologies is through the generation and editing of induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs). However, it is deemed necessary to derive transgene-free iPSCs for conservation target species, which can be highly time consuming and expensive. This study describes the generation of iPSCs from the marsupial fat-tailed dunnart (diPSCs) that serves as a model species for next generation conservation initiatives. These diPSCs exhibit features of totipotency when cells are maintained with exogenous reprogramming factors for long periods, until differentiation potential is required. Neonatal dunnart fibroblasts were reprogrammed using doxycycline-inducible Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, Lin28 and Myc, and the resulting iPSC lines were characterised at the transcriptomic, epigenetic and functional level (trilineage differentiation, embryoid body formation and mouse blastocyst injection assays). Dunnart iPSCs exhibited robust transcriptional and epigenetic activation of core pluripotency factors (POU5F1, POU5F3, SALL4) as well as factors associated with the naive and primed states of eutherian pluripotency (TBX3, KLF2, TFCP2L1, SOX11, DNMT3A). Dunnart iPSCs readily differentiated in trilineage and embryoid body formation assays, where they expressed markers of all three germ lineages. When injected into 8-cell mouse blastocysts, dunnart iPSCs integrated into both the inner cell mass and trophoblast, reflecting a capacity to contribute to embryonic and extra embryonic lineages during early development. Further, we show that diPSCs can maintain their potential in the presence of exogenous pluripotency factors, until required for differentiation. This robust iPSC generation and maintenance approach is a valuable avenue for the rapid application of next-generation conservation technologies in threatened species.
items.abstract_zh: 有袋类在近期和即将发生的哺乳动物灭绝中占不成比例的高比例，这促使人们投入开发“下一代”保护生物技术。这些技术包括生成经遗传选择/修饰的个体以提高种群适合度。鉴于研究受威胁物种的固有局限，开发这些技术的一种灵活载体是通过生成和编辑诱导多能干细胞（iPSCs）。然而，认为有必要为保护目标物种获得无转基因iPSCs，这可能非常耗时且昂贵。本研究描述了从有袋类肥尾袋鼩（fat-tailed dunnart）生成iPSCs（diPSCs），该物种作为下一代保护计划的模式物种。当细胞长期用外源性重编程因子维持时，这些diPSCs表现出全能性特征，直到需要分化潜能。新生儿袋鼩成纤维细胞使用多西环素诱导的Oct4、Sox2、Klf4、Lin28和Myc重编程，所得iPSC系在转录组、表观遗传和功能水平（三系分化、拟胚体形成和小鼠囊胚注射实验）进行表征。袋鼩iPSCs表现出核心多能性因子（POU5F1、POU5F3、SALL4）以及真兽类多能性naive和primed状态相关因子（TBX3、KLF2、TFCP2L1、SOX11、DNMT3A）的强转录和表观遗传激活。袋鼩iPSCs在三系分化和拟胚体形成实验中易于分化，并表达三个胚层谱系的标志物。当注射到8细胞期小鼠囊胚时，袋鼩iPSCs整合到内细胞团和滋养层中，反映其在早期发育中贡献于胚胎和胚外谱系的能力。进一步，我们表明diPSCs在外源性多能性因子存在下可维持其潜能，直到需要分化。这种稳健的iPSC生成和维持方法是将下一代保护技术快速应用于受威胁物种的有价值途径。

items.title_en: Exciton design via topological spin textures
items.title_zh: 通过拓扑自旋织构进行激子设计
items.abstract_en: Excitons carry energy and information through a semiconductor without carrying charge. This makes them attractive for optoelectronics, but also hard to guide. Magnetic skyrmions, on the other hand, are moved by small electrical currents. Here we develop a theory of excitons interacting with a skyrmion in which the electron and the hole are treated as distinct constituents, each with its own spin--orbit coupling. We find that the topology of the skyrmion is transferred to the exciton only when the exchange coupling exceeds the relevant spin--orbit splitting. The exciton then experiences a full flux quantum, with opposite signs in the two valleys. The quantum metric of the spin texture creates a ring-shaped barrier that traps excitons, whereas the topological charge fixes the angular momentum of the trapped states and hence their optical selection rules. Because the trap moves with the skyrmion, excitons can be transported by current pulses, and small skyrmions accommodate a single exciton, which opens the door for potential hybrid applications in future information technology intertwining topological magnetic bits with optical excitations.
items.abstract_zh: 激子在半导体中传输能量和信息而不携带电荷。这使其对光电子学有吸引力，但也难以引导。另一方面，磁斯格明子可由小电流驱动。我们发展了激子与斯格明子相互作用的理论，其中电子和空穴被视为不同组分，各自具有自己的自旋-轨道耦合。我们发现只有当交换耦合超过相关自旋-轨道分裂时，斯格明子的拓扑才转移到激子。激子随后经历一个完整磁通量子，在两个谷中符号相反。自旋织构的量子度规产生环形势垒捕获激子，而拓扑荷固定捕获态的角动量，从而决定其光学选择定则。由于陷阱随斯格明子移动，激子可由电流脉冲输运，小斯格明子可容纳单个激子，这为未来信息技术中拓扑磁比特与光激发交织的潜在混合应用打开了大门。

items.title_en: An Ultra-Low-Noise Tunable TIA in 45nm Silicon Photonics for Electro-Optical Ultrasound Data Acquisition
items.title_zh: 用于电光超声数据采集的45nm硅光子超低噪声可调TIA
items.abstract_en: This paper presents the design and experimental characterization of a 32-channel, WDM-compatible electronic-photonic receiver array fabricated in the GlobalFoundries 45nm monolithic silicon photonics process. Optimized for miniaturized, millimeter-scale electro-optical ultrasound data acquisition probes for broadband photo-acoustic imaging (PAI), the chip utilizes integrated micro-ring resonator (MRR) demultiplexers and photodiode (PD) arrays to decode multi-wavelength acoustic signals outside the body. This work focuses specifically on the comprehensive characterization of the receiver front-end, evaluating both the optical WDM filter bank and the transimpedance amplifier (TIA) performance. Monolithic co-integration minimizes critical photodiode-to-TIA interface parasitics. The TIA incorporates a DC-offset cancellation loop that compensates for photodiode-induced offset currents while providing tunable low-frequency cutoff control over a range of 30 kHz to 1.5 MHz. This tunability enables effective suppression of flicker noise and improves overall signal integrity. The front-end achieves the peak transimpedance gain of 144 dB$Ω$ while maintaining an ultra-low input-referred noise current density of $1\text{ pA}/\sqrt{\text{Hz}}$, demonstrating a highly scalable architecture for high-sensitivity intravascular and endobronchial imaging.
items.abstract_zh: 本文介绍在GlobalFoundries 45nm单片硅光子工艺中制造的32通道、兼容WDM的电子-光子接收器阵列的设计与实验表征。该芯片针对用于宽带光声成像（PAI）的小型化毫米级电光超声数据采集探头优化，利用集成微环谐振器（MRR）解复用器和光电二极管（PD）阵列在体外解码多波长声信号。本工作特别关注接收器前端的全面表征，评估光学WDM滤波器组和跨阻放大器（TIA）性能。单片共集成最小化关键的光电二极管到TIA接口寄生。TIA包含直流失调消除环路，补偿光电二极管引起的失调电流，同时在30 kHz至1.5 MHz范围内提供可调低频截止控制。这种可调性能够有效抑制闪烁噪声并改善整体信号完整性。前端实现144 dBΩ峰值跨阻增益，同时保持1 pA/√Hz的超低输入参考噪声电流密度，展示了用于高灵敏度血管内和支气管内成像的高度可扩展架构。
